code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Arrays" Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" ' ' Les fonctions définies dans cette bibliothèque de script permettent la gestion de tous les ' opérations reliés au formulaire Table | F_Tabl. '

Dim gns_FTabl As Notessession Dim gndb_FTabl As Notesdatabase Dim gnuiws_FTabl As Notesuiworkspace
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_FTabl = "SL" Const gc_Element_FTabl = "F_Tabl"

Sub FTabl_Querysave(pnuid_Source As Notesuidocument, p_Continue As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument
p_Continue = False
Call FTabl_Initialisations Set nd = pnuid_Source.Document
' Initialisation des champs cachés liés aux descriptions Call FTabl_InitTable(nd)
' Initialisation des champs cachés liés aux compléments Call FTabl_InitComplement(nd, "1") Call FTabl_InitComplement(nd, "2") Call FTabl_InitComplement(nd, "3") Call FTabl_InitComplement(nd, "4")
p_Continue = True Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FTabl_InitComplement(pnd As Notesdocument, p_NoComplement As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_aValeursComp() As String Dim i As Long
' Initialisation des champs cachés liés aux complément Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem("Tabl_Complement" & p_NoComplement) If Ubound(ni.Values) > 0 Or ni.Values(0) <> "" Then Redim v_aValeursComp(Ubound(ni.Values)) As String For i = Lbound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) To Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) v_aValeursComp(i) = ni.Values(i) & "|" & pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) Next If xVar(pnd, "Tabl_TrierDescriptions", "") = "1" Then Call TrierArray(v_aValeursComp) End If Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursComp" & p_NoComplement, v_aValeursComp) Else Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursComp" & p_NoComplement, pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub FTabl_Initialisations If gns_FTabl Is Nothing Then Set gns_FTabl = New Notessession Set gndb_FTabl = gns_FTabl.Currentdatabase Set gnuiws_FTabl = New Notesuiworkspace End If End Sub

Sub FTabl_acTrierLesValeurs On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim a_Valeurs As Variant
Call FTabl_Initialisations
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call Gnuiws_FTabl.Currentdocument.Refresh On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur
' Trier les tableaux de valeurs et de descriptions Set nd = Gnuiws_FTabl.Currentdocument.Document
' Trier les tableaux Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Descriptions") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Icones") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Complement1") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Complement2") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Complement3") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Complement4")
' Trier les valeurs a_Valeurs = xVarArray(nd, "Tabl_Valeurs") If TrierArray(a_Valeurs) Then nd.Tabl_Valeurs = a_Valeurs End If FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_Valeurs As Variant Dim a_Descriptions As Variant
a_Valeurs = xVarArray(pnd, "Tabl_Valeurs")
' Trier les valeurs If Ubound(a_Valeurs) > 0 Then a_Descriptions = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If Trier2Arrays(a_Valeurs, a_Descriptions) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, a_Descriptions) End If End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FTabl_InitTable(pnd As Notesdocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_aValeursAlias() As String Dim v_aValeursDesc() As String Dim v_aValeursDescAlias() As String Dim v_aValeursComp1() As String Dim v_aValeursComp2() As String Dim i As Long
' Initialisation des champs cachés liés aux descriptions If Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Descriptions) > 0 Or pnd.Tabl_Descriptions(0) <> "" Then Redim v_aValeursAlias(Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs)) As String Redim v_aValeursDesc(Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs)) As String Redim v_aValeursDescAlias(Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs)) As String
For i = Lbound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) To Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) v_aValeursAlias(i) = pnd.Tabl_Descriptions(i) & "|" & pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) v_aValeursDesc(i) = pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) & " - " & pnd.Tabl_Descriptions(i) v_aValeursDescAlias(i) = pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) & " - " & pnd.Tabl_Descriptions(i) & "|" & pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) Next
If xVar(pnd, "Tabl_TrierDescriptions", "") = "1" Then Call TrierArray(v_aValeursAlias) End If Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursAlias", v_aValeursAlias) Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursDesc", v_aValeursDesc) Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursDescAlias", v_aValeursDescAlias) Else Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursAlias", pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursDesc", pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursDescAlias", pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Selection" Use "SI_NAB" Use "x_GDK" Use "x_SICf" Use "x_SICl"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_SICf As NotesSession Dim gndb_SICf As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_SICf As NotesUIWorkspace
' Traitement des erreurs ' ------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SICf = "SL" Const gc_Element_SICf = "SI_Configurations"

Function SICf_ConnexionVPN_m(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_TypeConnexion As String, pnd_Conf As NotesDocument, pnd_Serv As NotesDocument, pa() As String, p_ParametresOptionnels As String) As Boolean ' Connexion + Merlin On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Merl As NotesDocument
Dim v_Prefixe As String Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_Utilisateur As String Dim v_MotPasse As String
SICf_ConnexionVPN_m = False
If p_TypeConnexion = "m" Or p_TypeConnexion = "g" Then Call SICf_ndServMerl(p_ClientNoFmt, p_TypeConnexion, pnd_Conf, pnd_Serv, nd_Merl) ElseIf Not SICf_ndServWindows(p_ClientNoFmt, pnd_Conf, pnd_Serv) Then Exit Function ' Picklist - Cancel End If
' Extraire le préfixe du document de configuration v_Prefixe = StrRight(xVar(pnd_Serv, "Form", ""), "_") & "_"
' Validations If xVar(pnd_Serv, v_Prefixe & "Plateforme", "") <> "Windows" Then ' 25: Aucun serveur windows trouvé pour le client &. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 25, "", p_ClientNoFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If If p_TypeConnexion = "g" Then ' RemoteApp Set ni = pnd_Serv.GetFirstItem("Serv_Usages") If Not (ni.contains("ML") And ni.Contains("TS")) Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 27, "", p_ClientNoFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If
' Adesse de connexion pa(11) = xVar(pnd_Serv, v_Prefixe & "NATAdresseIp", "") If pa(11) = "" Then p_TypeConnexion = "1" ' PPTP pa(11) = xVar(pnd_Serv, v_Prefixe & "AdresseIp", "") End If If pa(11) = "" Then ' 20: Impossible de déterminer l'adresse du serveur. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 20, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
If p_TypeConnexion <> "m" And p_TypeConnexion <> "q" Then pa(10) = "" End If
Call SICf_UtilisateurSDSMerl(p_TypeConnexion, pnd_Serv, v_Utilisateur, v_MotPasse) If v_Utilisateur = "" Then If p_TypeConnexion = "g" Or p_TypeConnexion = "m" Then ' RemoteApp MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 28, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If Else p_ParametresOptionnels = "[=" & v_Utilisateur & "][$" & v_MotPasse & "]" End If
If p_TypeConnexion = "q" Then ' Bureau à distance (console) p_TypeConnexion = "p" End If
SICf_ConnexionVPN_m = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICf_ConnexionVPN(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_TypeConnexion As String, pnd_Conf As NotesDocument) %REM -------------------------- p_TypeConnexion ------------------------------ c = Client Access p = rdc g = RemoteApp Merlin q = rdc console j = JWalk r = routeur m = rdc console Merlin s = console (VNC) o = StatsOnline z = VPN slm -------------------------- SertiVPN.exe -------------------------- ARG1 -Identifiant du client [nomInterne #noFmt] ex: [Autoworld Mazda Leduc #581-000] ARG2 - Adresse IP du VPN ex: [vwvaudre.sds.serti.net] ARG3 - Code usager du VPN ex: [sds] ARG4 - Mot de passe du VPN ex: [sds7555] ARG5 - Adresse IP du serveur IBM i ex: [192.168.1.1] ARG6 - Nom de la connexion sur le TS [interne] ex: [Autoworld] ARG7 - Type de connexion ex: [c] ou [j] ou [v] ou [r] ou [s] ou [m] ou [p] ou [g] ARG8 - Version SDS ex: [52g] ARG9 - Adresse IP du routeur [router] ex: [192.168.77.1] ARG10 - Adresse IP de la console [console] ex: [192.168.77.27] ARG11 - Adresse IP du serveur Windows [merlin] ex: [192.168.22.250] ARG12 - Partie entière du no de client ex: [#581]
Paramêtres optionnels & - Mot de passe de l'utilisateur SUPPORT ex.:[&MOTPASSE] @ - URL à ouvrir ex.:StatsOnline = - Code utilisateur Merlin ex.:[=ADMIN] $ - Mot de passe de l'utilisateur Merlin ex.:[$MOTPASSE] EXEMPLE COMPLET: c:\program files\SertiVPN\SertiVPN.exe [Autoworld Mazda Leduc #581-000][142.179.184.248][sds][sds][172.21.81.250][Autoworld][j][52g][router][console][merlin][#581] %END REM On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_TypeConnexion As String ' 0 = IpSec, 1 = PPTP Dim nd_VPN As NotesDocument Dim a(1 To 12) As String Dim s As String Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument ' Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument ' Dim nd_Merl As NotesDocument Dim v_Command As String ' Dim v_Prefixe As String Dim v_ParametresOptionnels As String Dim v_Result As Integer ' Dim v_Utilisateur As String ' Dim v_MotPasse As String Dim v_VPN_TypeConnexion As Variant Dim v_Roles As Variant Dim v_ProgrammeVPN As String Dim ni As NotesItem
Const c_ProgrammeVPN = "c:\program files\SertiVPN\LotusSertiVPN.exe"
' Initialisations Call SICf_Initialisations SICf_ConnexionVPN = False
' Vérifier que le Serti VPN est installé On Error 76 Resume Next %REM If Dir$("c:\program files\SertiVPN\LotusSertiVPN.exe") = "" Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 13, "", "SertiVPN"), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If %END REM
' Initialisation des paramètres If p_TypeConnexion = "" Then p_TypeConnexion = "v" Else p_TypeConnexion = Lcase(p_TypeConnexion) End If
Set nd_VPN = SICf_ndVPN(p_ClientNoFmt, p_TypeConnexion) v_TypeConnexion = "0" ' IPSEC v_VPN_TypeConnexion = xvarArray(nd_VPN, "VPN_TypeConnexion") If IsArray(v_VPN_TypeConnexion) then If Ubound(v_VPN_TypeConnexion) = 0 And v_VPN_TypeConnexion(0) = "1" Then v_TypeConnexion = "1" ' PPTP End If End if
a(1) = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom1", "", True) & " #" & p_ClientNoFmt a(2) = xVar(nd_VPN, "VPN_AdresseIP", "AdresseIPVPN") a(3) = xVar(nd_VPN, "VPN_Usager", "UsagerVPN") a(4) = xVar(nd_VPN, "VPN_MotPasse", "MotDePasseVPN") a(5) = "" ' a(7) = p_Type & xVar(nd_VPN, "VPN_Protocole", "0") & xVar(nd_VPN, "VPN_Encryption", "0") a(6) = "IPSEC" a(8) = "" a(9) = "router" a(10) = "console" a(11) = "merlin" a(12) = "#" & Strleft(p_ClientNoFmt, "-")
Select Case p_TypeConnexion Case "r" : ' Connexion + Routeur If SICf_ConnexionVPN_r(p_TypeConnexion, nd_VPN, a) = False Then Exit Function End If
Case "m", "p", "q", "g" : If SICf_ConnexionVPN_m(p_ClientNoFmt, p_TypeConnexion, pnd_Conf, nd_Serv, a, v_ParametresOptionnels) = False Then Exit Function End If
Case "s" : ' Connexion + Console If SICf_ConnexionVPN_s(p_ClientNoFmt, p_TypeConnexion, pnd_Conf, nd_Serv, a) = False Then Exit Function End If
Case "j", "c" : ' Connexion + ClientAccess ou JWalk If SICf_ConnexionVPN_j(p_ClientNoFmt, p_TypeConnexion, pnd_Conf, nd_Serv, a, v_ParametresOptionnels) = False Then Exit Function End If
Case "o" : ' StatsOnline %REM If SICf_ConnexionVPN_o(p_ClientNoFmt, p_TypeConnexion, pnd_Conf, nd_Serv, a) = False Then Exit Function End If
%END REM End Select
If v_TypeConnexion = "1" Then ' PPTP a(6) = "PPTP" End If
' Valider si l'utilisateur est autorisé à utiliser le serveur If Not (nd_Serv Is Nothing) Then If Not SICf_ConnectionAutorisee(nd_Serv) Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 23, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End If
If nd_VPN Is Nothing Then ' Le client n'a pas de VPN ' Connexion PPTP - Le document VPN est obligatoire If v_TypeConnexion <> "0" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 3, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If Else ' Le client a un VPN ' Valider si l'utilisateur est autorisé à utiliser le VPN If Not SICf_ConnectionAutorisee(nd_VPN) Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 21, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If End if
' Vérifier que l'application SertiVPN est installée ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------ v_ProgrammeVPN = xSICf_xVarProf("Prof_ProgrammeVPN", "") If v_ProgrammeVPN = "" Then v_ProgrammeVPN = c_ProgrammeVPN Elseif Dir$(v_ProgrammeVPN) = "" Then v_ProgrammeVPN = c_ProgrammeVPN End If If Dir$(v_ProgrammeVPN) = "" Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 13, "", "SertiVPN"), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
' Etablir la connexion VPN et l'action supplémentaire ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------ a(7) = p_TypeConnexion & xVar(nd_VPN, "VPN_Protocole", "0") & xVar(nd_VPN, "VPN_Encryption", "0") v_Command = v_ProgrammeVPN & " [" & Implode(a, "][") & "]" & v_ParametresOptionnels v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) = 1 Then Print v_Command End If
v_Result = Shell(v_Command, 1) If v_Result <> 33 Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 6, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
SICf_ConnexionVPN = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICf_ConnexionVPN_j(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_TypeConnexion As String, pnd_Conf As NotesDocument, pnd_Serv As NotesDocument, pa() As String, p_ParametresOptionnels As String) As Boolean ' Connexion + Jwalk On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument
Dim v_MotPasse As String
SICf_ConnexionVPN_j = False
If Not SICf_ndServSDS(p_ClientNoFmt, p_TypeConnexion, pnd_Conf, pnd_Serv, nd_SDS) Then Exit Function 'si l'utilisateur cancel le picklist End If
' Validations If xVar(pnd_Serv, "Serv_Plateforme", "") <> "iSeries" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 24, "", p_ClientNoFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If If p_TypeConnexion = "j" And nd_SDS Is Nothing Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 14, "", p_ClientNoFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
' Adesse de connexion pa(5) = xVar(pnd_Serv, "Serv_NATAdresseIp", "") If pa(5) = "" Then p_TypeConnexion = "1" ' PPTP pa(5) = xVar(pnd_Serv, "Serv_AdresseIp", "") End If If pa(5) = "" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 20, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
pa(8) = xVar(nd_SDS, "SDS_VersionSDS", "") If InStr(pa(8), ".") > 0 Then pa(8) = StrLeft(pa(8), ".") & StrRightBack(pa(8), ".") End If
pa(12) = "#" & StrLeft(xVar(pnd_Serv, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", ""), "-")
v_MotPasse = xVar(pnd_Serv, "SDS_MotPasse", "") If v_MotPasse <> "" Then p_ParametresOptionnels = "[&" & v_MotPasse & "]" End If
SICf_ConnexionVPN_j = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SICf_UtilisateurSDSMerl(p_TypeConnexion As String, pnd_Serv As NotesDocument, p_Utilisateur As String, p_MotDePasse As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Merl As NotesDocument Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument
p_Utilisateur = ""
If p_TypeConnexion = "g" Then p_Utilisateur = xSICf_xVarProf("Prof_UtilisateurRemoteApp", "") p_MotDePasse = xSICf_xVarProf("Prof_MotDePasseRemoteApp", "") End If
If p_Utilisateur = "" Then p_Utilisateur = xVar(pnd_Serv, "Serv_UtilisateurAdmin", "") p_MotDePasse = xVar(pnd_Serv, "Serv_MotDePasseAdmin", "") End If
If p_Utilisateur = "" or p_MotDePasse = "" Then p_Utilisateur = "" End if Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SICf_SelectionnerServeur(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_TypeServeur As String) As Notesdocument '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' permet de sélectionner un serveur ou ordinateur par plateforme. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb_SICf As NotesDatabase Dim ndc_Serv As notesdocumentcollection Dim nd_Serv As notesdocument Dim nv_Serv As notesview Dim nv_Conf24 As notesview Dim v_Cle As String
Set ndb_SICf = xGDK_xndbNDB("SI Configurations")
If nv_Conf24 Is Nothing Then Set nv_Conf24 = ndb_SICf.getview("V_Conf24") End If
v_Cle = p_ClientNoFmt & ";" & p_TypeServeur Set ndc_Serv = xndc(v_Cle, ndb_SICf , "V_Conf24", nv_Serv)
' Sélectionner un serveur ' ------------------------------- If ndc_Serv.count = 0 Then ' message aucune serveur windows Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 22, "", p_ClientNoFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function Elseif ndc_Serv.count = 1 Then Set SICf_SelectionnerServeur = ndc_Serv.GetFirstDocument Elseif ndc_Serv.count > 1 Then Set SICf_SelectionnerServeur = SISe_ndSelectionnerDocument("", "", SISe_PICKLIST, _ nv_Conf24, v_Cle, xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 17, "", ""), v_Cle, True) End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SICf_Initialisations If gns_SICf Is Nothing Then Set gns_SICf = New NotesSession End If End Sub

Function SICf_ConnectionAutorisee(pnd_TypeConnection As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Cette fonction permet de vérifier si l'usager peut utliser la connection VPN ou Serveur ' Si admin connection authorisé, sinon l'usager doit être dans le champ Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises pour utliser la connection. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Roles As Variant Dim v_Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises As Variant Dim v_GroupesUtilisateur As Variant Dim ni_Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises As notesitem
' Initialisations SICf_ConnectionAutorisee = False
' Vérifie si l'usager a le rôle Admin. v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) = 1 Then SICf_ConnectionAutorisee = True Exit Function End If
' Vérifie si l'usager est dans le champ Utilisateurs Authorisés v_Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises = Evaluate(|@IsMember(@Name([Abbreviate];@UserName); Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises)| , pnd_TypeConnection) If v_Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises(0) = 1 Then SICf_ConnectionAutorisee = True Exit Function End If
' Vérifie si l'usager est dans une des groupes du champ Utilisateurs Authorisés If pnd_TypeConnection.HasItem("Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises") Then Set ni_Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises = pnd_TypeConnection.GetFirstItem("Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises") v_GroupesUtilisateur = NAB_GroupesUtilisateur(gns_SICf.Username) If Isarray(v_GroupesUtilisateur) Then Forall v_Groupe In ni_Conf_UtilisateursAuthorises.Values If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(v_GroupesUtilisateur, v_Groupe)) Then SICf_ConnectionAutorisee = True Exit Function End If End Forall End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SICf_BureauADistance(p_AdresseIp As String, p_Taille As Integer, p_Admin As Boolean) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' p_Taille : 0 = Full screen, 1024 = 1024x768, 1280 = 1280x960, etc. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Command As String Dim w As Integer Dim h As Integer Dim v_Result As Integer
v_Command = "%systemroot%\system32\mstsc.exe /v:" & p_AdresseIp
If p_Taille > 0 Then w = p_Taille h = p_Taille / 1024 * 768 v_Command = v_Command & " /w:" & Cstr(w) & " /h:" & Cstr(h) Else v_Command = v_Command & " /f" End If
If p_Admin Then v_Command = v_Command & " /admin" End If
v_Result = Shell(v_Command, 1) If v_Result <> 33 Then Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 6, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SICf_ndServMerl(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_Type As String, pnd_Conf As NotesDocument, pnd_Serv As NotesDocument, _ pnd_Merl As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' permet de retourner le document Merlin et serveur parent du client Merlin si il existe '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NoConfigurationServeur As String
SICf_ndServMerl = True
If xVar(pnd_Conf, "Form", "") = "F_Merl" Then Set pnd_Merl = pnd_Conf v_NoConfigurationServeur = xVar(pnd_Conf, "Merl_NoConfigurationServeur", "") Else Set pnd_Merl = SICF_ndSDSMerl(p_ClientNoFmt, p_Type, v_NoConfigurationServeur) End If If v_NoConfigurationServeur <> "" Then Set pnd_Serv = xSICf_xndServ(v_NoConfigurationServeur, True) End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICf_ndSDSMerl(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_Type As String, p_NoConfigurationServeur As String) As NotesDocument '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' permet de retourner le document du client SDS ou Merlin et le NoConfigurationServeur si il existe '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Merl As NotesDocument Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument
p_NoConfigurationServeur = ""
' Connection Merlin demandée If p_Type = "m" Or p_Type = "g" Then Set nd_Merl = xSICf_xndMerl(p_ClientNoFmt, True) If Not (nd_Merl Is Nothing) Then p_NoConfigurationServeur = xVar(nd_Merl, "Merl_NoConfigurationServeur", "") Set SICf_ndSDSMerl = nd_Merl End If ' Connection SDS demandée Else Set nd_SDS = xSICf_xndSDS(p_ClientNoFmt, True) If Not (nd_SDS Is Nothing) Then p_NoConfigurationServeur = xVar(nd_SDS, "SDS_NoConfigurationServeur", "") Set SICf_ndSDSMerl = nd_SDS End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICf_CreerConfigurationMerlin(p_ClientNoFmt As String) As NotesDocument ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Cette fonction permet de créer un document Merlin dans SI Configurations. ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_Merl As NotesDocument Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_Merlin_NoConfigurationServeur As String Dim nv_Serv21 As NotesView
' Initialisations Call SICf_Initialisations Call xSICf_Initialisation
' Créer le nouveau document Set nd_Merl = New NotesDocument(gndb_xSICf)
' Intialize les champs F_Merl nd_Merl.Form = "F_Merl" nd_Merl.Conf_NoConfiguration = Evaluate("@Right(@Unique; 6)") nd_Merl.Cle = xVar(nd_Merl, "Conf_NoConfiguration", "") nd_Merl.Description = p_ClientNoFmt & "SDS Merlin" nd_Merl.Conf_Type = "SDS Merlin" nd_Merl.Conf_Icone = 59
' Saisir les informations du client nd_Merl.Conf_ClientNo1 = CInt(StrLeft(p_ClientNoFmt, "-")) nd_Merl.Conf_ClientNo2 = StrRight(p_ClientNoFmt, "-") nd_Merl.Conf_ClientNoFmt = p_ClientNoFmt nd_Merl.Conf_ClientNom1 = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom1", "", True) nd_Merl.Conf_ClientNom2 = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom2", "", True) nd_Merl.Merl_ClientNomInterne = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "", True) nd_Merl.Clie_ClientCategorie = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt , "Clie_ClientCategorie", "", True)
' Initialize le serveur parent Set nv_Serv21 = gndb_xSICf.GetView("V_Serv21") Set nd_Serv = nv_Serv21.GetDocumentByKey(p_ClientNoFmt & ";ML", True) If Not nd_Serv Is Nothing Then nd_Merl.Merl_NoConfigurationServeur = xVar(nd_Serv, "Conf_NoConfiguration", "") End If
' Historique nd_Merl.HistoDC = Now nd_Merl.HistoUC = gns_SICf.Username
' Sécurité Set ni = New NotesItem(nd_Merl, "Lecteurs", Evaluate( |"[Admin]" : "[catTous]" : "[cat| & _ Right("00" & xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientCategorie", "", True), 2) & |]"|), READERS) Set ni = New NotesItem(nd_Merl, "Auteurs", Evaluate(|"[SDS]" : "[Admin]"|), AUTHORS)
Call nd_Merl.Save(True,False) Set SICf_CreerConfigurationMerlin = nd_Merl Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SICf_OuvrirServeurSDS(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_Usage As String) On Error Goto GererErreur ' Voir SI_Clients pour exemple %REM ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ouvrir le document de configuration SDS. Paramètres: p_NoClient String. Le numéro du client à afficher. Paramètres: p_Usage String. Le type d' usage du serveur. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ %ENDREM
Dim ndc_Serv As NotesDocumentcollection Dim v_Cle As String Dim nv_Serv As notesview Dim nd_Serv As notesdocument Dim nv_Serv21 As NotesView Dim ndb_SICf As NotesDatabase
Set ndb_SICf = xGDK_xndbNDB("SI Configurations")
If gnuiws_SICf Is Nothing Then Set gnuiws_SICf = New NotesUIWorkspace End If
If nv_Serv21 Is Nothing Then Set nv_Serv21 = ndb_SICf.Getview("V_Serv21") End If
v_Cle = p_ClientNoFmt & ";" & p_Usage Set ndc_Serv = xndc(v_Cle, ndb_SICf , "V_Serv21", nv_Serv)
If ndc_Serv.count = 0 Then ' message aucune serveur sds Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 16, "", p_ClientNoFmt), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub Elseif ndc_Serv.count = 1 Then Set nd_Serv = ndc_Serv.GetFirstDocument Elseif ndc_Serv.count > 1 Then 'si count plus que 1 afficher picklist Set nd_Serv = SICf_ndSelectionnerServeurSDS(p_ClientNoFmt, p_Usage) End If
If Not nd_Serv Is Nothing Then Call gnuiws_SICf.EditDocument(False, nd_Serv,,,, False) End If
Exit Sub

Function SICf_CreerConfigurationSDS(p_ClientNoFmt As String) As NotesDocument '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Cette fonction permet de créer un document SDS dans SI Configurations. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_SDS_NoConfigurationServeur As String Dim nv_Serv21 As notesview
' Initialisations Call SICf_Initialisations Call xSICf_Initialisation
' Créer le nouveau document Set nd_SDS = New notesdocument(gndb_xSICf)
' Intialize les champs F_SDS nd_SDS.Form = "F_SDS" nd_SDS.Conf_NoConfiguration = Evaluate("@Right(@Unique; 6)") nd_SDS.Cle = xVar(nd_SDS, "Conf_NoConfiguration", "") nd_SDS.Description = p_ClientNoFmt & "SDS" nd_SDS.Conf_Type = "SDS" nd_SDS.Conf_Icone = 174
' Saisir les informations du client nd_SDS.Conf_ClientNo1 = Cint(Strleft(p_ClientNoFmt, "-")) nd_SDS.Conf_ClientNo2 = Strright(p_ClientNoFmt, "-") nd_SDS.Conf_ClientNoFmt = p_ClientNoFmt nd_SDS.Conf_ClientNom1 = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom1", "", True) nd_SDS.Conf_ClientNom2 = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNom2", "", True) nd_SDS.SDS_ClientNomInterne = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "", True) nd_SDS.Clie_ClientCategorie = xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt , "Clie_ClientCategorie", "", True)
' Initialize le serveur parent Set nv_Serv21 = gndb_xSICf.GetView("V_Serv21") Set nd_Serv = nv_Serv21.GetDocumentByKey(p_ClientNoFmt & ";SDS", True) If Not nd_Serv Is Nothing Then nd_SDS.SDS_NoConfigurationServeur = xVar(nd_Serv, "Conf_NoConfiguration", "") End If
' Historique nd_SDS.HistoDC = Now nd_SDS.HistoUC = gns_SICf.Username
' Sécurité Set ni = New NotesItem(nd_SDS, "Lecteurs", Evaluate( |"[Admin]" : "[catTous]" : "[cat| & _ Right("00" & xSICl_xVarClie(p_ClientNoFmt, "Clie_ClientCategorie", "", True), 2) & |]"|), READERS) Set ni = New NotesItem(nd_SDS, "Auteurs", Evaluate(|"[SDS]" : "[Admin]"|), AUTHORS)
Call nd_SDS.Save(True,False) Set SICf_CreerConfigurationSDS = nd_SDS Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICf_ndServSDS(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_Type As String, pnd_Conf As NotesDocument, pnd_Serv As NotesDocument, _ pnd_SDS As NotesDocument) As Boolean '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' permet de retourner le document SDS et serveur parent du client SDS si il existe '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_NoConfigurationServeur As String
SICf_ndServSDS = True
If xVar(pnd_Conf, "Form", "") = "F_Serv" And xVar(pnd_Conf, "Serv_Plateforme", "") = "iSeries" Then Set pnd_Serv = pnd_Conf Set pnd_SDS = SICF_ndSDSMerl(p_ClientNoFmt, p_Type, v_NoConfigurationServeur)
Else If xVar(pnd_Conf, "Form", "") = "F_SDS" Then Set pnd_SDS = pnd_Conf v_NoConfigurationServeur = xVar(pnd_SDS, "SDS_NoConfigurationServeur", "") Else Set pnd_SDS = SICF_ndSDSMerl(p_ClientNoFmt, p_Type, v_NoConfigurationServeur) End If If v_NoConfigurationServeur <> "" Then Set pnd_Serv = xSICf_xndServ(v_NoConfigurationServeur, True) End If End If
If pnd_Serv Is Nothing And p_Type <> "j" Then ' Pas un client SDS, sélectionner le serveur Set pnd_Serv = SICf_SelectionnerServeur(p_ClientNoFmt, "iSeries") If (pnd_Serv Is Nothing) Then ' Si l'utilisateur cancel le picklist SICf_ndServSDS = False End If End If
Exit Function GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SICf_ndVPN(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_Type As String) As NotesDocument On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_VPN As NotesDocument Dim nd_SDSMerl Dim v_NoConfigurationServeur As String Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument Dim v_NoClientParent As String
'Extraire le document de VPN ' ---------------------------------------- Set nd_VPN = xSICf_xndVPN(p_ClientNoFmt, True)
' Si pas de VPN, Extraire le VPN du client du parent - si existe If nd_VPN Is Nothing Then If p_Type = "m" Then Set nd_SDSMerl = SICf_ndSDSMerl(p_ClientNoFmt, p_Type, v_NoConfigurationServeur)
If v_NoConfigurationServeur <> "" Then Set nd_Serv = xSICf_xndServ(v_NoConfigurationServeur, True) v_NoClientParent = xVar(nd_Serv, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", "") If v_NoClientParent <> "" And v_NoClientParent <> p_ClientNoFmt Then Set nd_VPN = xSICf_xndVPN(v_NoClientParent, True) Else v_NoConfigurationServeur = "" End If End If End If
If v_NoConfigurationServeur = "" Then Set nd_SDSMerl = SICf_ndSDSMerl(p_ClientNoFmt, "", v_NoConfigurationServeur) End If
If nd_VPN Is Nothing And v_NoConfigurationServeur <> "" Then Set nd_Serv = xSICf_xndServ(v_NoConfigurationServeur, True) v_NoClientParent = xVar(nd_Serv, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", "") If v_NoClientParent <> "" And v_NoClientParent <> p_ClientNoFmt Then Set nd_VPN = xSICf_xndVPN(v_NoClientParent, True) End If End If End If
Set SICf_ndVPN = nd_VPN Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SICf, gc_Element_SICf, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" ' ' Les fonctions définies dans cette bibliothèque permettent de manipuler des tableaux de valeurs.

Dim gns_SIAr As NotesSession Dim gndb_SIAr As NotesDatabase Dim gnd_SIAr As NotesDocument Dim gni_SIAr As NotesItem
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIA = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIA = "SI_Arrays"

Function TrierArray(pa As Variant) As Boolean ' ----------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trier un array. ' ----------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
TrierArray = False If Isarray(pa) Then TrierArray = Trier2Arrays_(pa, "") End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIa, gc_Element_SIa, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function RetirerArray(pArray As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant) As Variant ' ------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retirer une des valeurs de l'array. ' ------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Maj As Integer Dim v_aArray() As Variant Dim i As Long Dim j As Long
RetirerArray = Null
If Isarray(pArray) Then If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(pArray, p_Valeur)) Then j = -1 For i = Lbound(pArray) To Ubound(pArray) If pArray(i) <> p_Valeur Then j = j + 1 Redim Preserve v_aArray(j) As Variant v_aArray(j) = pArray(i) v_Maj = True End If Next End If
If v_Maj Then RetirerArray = v_aArray End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIA, gc_Element_SIA, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function PositionArraySuperieur(pArray As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant) As Integer ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trouver une valeur dans une liste de bornes supérieures ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Long
PositionArraySuperieur = -1
If Isarray(pArray) Then If p_Valeur > pArray(Ubound(pArray)) Then PositionArraySuperieur = Ubound(pArray) Else For i = Lbound(pArray) To Ubound(pArray) If p_Valeur <= pArray(i) Then PositionArraySuperieur = i Exit Function End If Next End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIA, gc_Element_SIA, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function Trier2Arrays_(pa_1 As Variant, pa_2 As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_aElem As Long Dim a_lBound() As Long Dim a_uBound() As Long Dim x As Long Dim r As Long Dim m As Variant Dim i As Long Dim t As Variant Dim k As Long
Trier2Arrays_ = False v_aElem = 0 Redim a_lBound(v_aElem) As Long Redim a_uBound(v_aElem) As Long a_lBound(v_aElem) = Lbound(pa_1) a_uBound(v_aElem) = Ubound(pa_1)
Do Until v_aElem < 0 x = a_lBound(v_aElem) r = a_uBound(v_aElem)
If r > x Then m = pa_1(x) k = r i = x
While (i < k) While (pa_1(i) <= m And i < r) i = i + 1 Wend While (pa_1(k) > m) k = k - 1 Wend If i < k Then Call SIAr_EchangerValeurs(pa_1, i, k) If Isarray(pa_2) Then Call SIAr_EchangerValeurs(pa_2, i, k) End If End If Wend
Call SIAr_EchangerValeurs(pa_1, x, k) If Isarray(pa_2) Then Call SIAr_EchangerValeurs(pa_2, x, k) End If
' Trier l'array de gauche a_lBound(v_aElem) = x a_uBound(v_aElem) = k - 1
' Trier l'array de droite v_aElem = v_aElem + 1 Redim Preserve a_lBound(v_aElem) As Long Redim Preserve a_uBound(v_aElem) As Long a_lBound(v_aElem) = k + 1 a_uBound(v_aElem) = r Else v_aElem = v_aElem - 1 End If Loop
Trier2Arrays_ = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIa, gc_Element_SIa, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function DimensionsArray(pa As Variant) As Integer ' -------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de savoir le nombre de dimensions d'un array. ' -------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 9 Goto FinSub
Dim v As Integer
DimensionsArray = 0
If Isarray(pa) Then Do DimensionsArray = DimensionsArray + 1 v = Lbound(pa, DimensionsArray + 1) Loop End If
FinSub: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIA, gc_Element_SIA, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SommeArray(pArray As Variant) As Variant '--------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de calculer la somme des éléments d'un array. '--------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur

Function SIAr_ValeursManquantes(p_Liste_1 As Variant, p_Liste_2 As Variant) As Variant 'SIAr_ValeursManquantes On Error Goto GererErreur ' ================================================================================================= ' Cette function compare 2 listes de string et retourne les valeurs manquantes de la premiere liste ' p_Liste_1: Liste où on recherche les valeurs ' p_Liste_2: Liste des valeurs recherchées ' retourne une string des valeurs séparées par c_Separateur ' =================================================================================================
Dim v_Valeurs As String Dim v_isVide As Boolean Const c_Seperateur = "/*/"
v_isVide = True
If Not Isarray(p_Liste_1) Then ' Print "Not Array p_Liste_1: " & p_Liste_1 p_Liste_1 = Evaluate(p_Liste_1)
End If
If Not Isarray(p_Liste_2) Then ' Print "Not Array p_Liste_2: " & p_Liste_2 p_Liste_2 = Evaluate(p_Liste_2) End If
If Isarray(p_Liste_1) And Isarray(p_Liste_2) Then Forall value2 In p_Liste_2
If Isnull(Arraygetindex(p_Liste_1, value2)) Then ' valeur non trouvé
If v_isVide Then v_Valeurs = value2 v_isVide = False Else v_Valeurs = v_Valeurs & c_Seperateur & value2 End If
End If End Forall
End If
' Print "SIAr_ValeursManquantes p_Liste_1 : " & Join(p_Liste_1, ",") ' Print "SIAr_ValeursManquantes p_Liste_2 : " & Join(p_Liste_2, ",") ' Print "SIAr_ValeursManquantes v_Valeurs: " & v_Valeurs
If v_Valeurs = "" Then SIAr_ValeursManquantes = "" Else SIAr_ValeursManquantes = Split(v_Valeurs, c_Seperateur) End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIa, gc_Element_SIa, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function Trier2Arrays(pa_1 As Variant, pa_2 As Variant) As Boolean ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trier un array et les valeurs correspondantes d'un deuxième array. ' Ex. : 2 - C 1 - D ' 4 - A --------> 2 - C ' 1 - D 3 - B ' 3 - B 4 - A ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Trier2Arrays = False If Isarray(pa_1) And Isarray(pa_2) Then If Lbound(pa_1) = Lbound(pa_2) And Ubound(pa_1) = Ubound(pa_2) Then Trier2Arrays = Trier2Arrays_(pa_1, pa_2) End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIa, gc_Element_SIa, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function PositionArrayInferieur(pArray As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant) As Integer ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trouver une valeur dans une liste de bornes inférieures ' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Long
PositionArrayInferieur = -1
If Isarray(pArray) Then For i = Ubound(pArray) To Lbound(pArray) Step -1 If p_Valeur >= pArray(i) Then PositionArrayInferieur = i Exit Function End If Next End If Exit Function

Function SIAr_DifferenceEntreDeuxListes(p_Liste1 As Variant, p_Liste2 As Variant) As Variant ' ============================================================================= ' Cette fonction retourne les éléments différents entre 2 listes ' EX: p_List1 = {[Québec], [Montréal], [Joliette], [Gaspé], [Trois-Rivères]}. ' p_List2 = {[Montréal], [Rimouski], [Trois-Rivères], [Québec]}. ' ' Valeure retournée : {[Joliette], [Gaspé], [Rimouski]}. ' ============================================================================= On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_ListDiff As Variant Dim v_Formule As String
Dim txtList1 As String Dim txtList2 As String
txtList1 = |"| & Join(p_Liste1, |":"|) & |"| txtList2 = |"| & Join(p_Liste2, |":"|) & |"|
v_Formule = |@Explode(@Implode(@Replace(| & txtList1 & |;| & txtList2 & |;"")) + @Implode(@Replace(| & txtList2 & |;| & txtList1 & |;"")))| v_ListDiff = Evaluate(v_Formule)
If Trim(Join(v_ListDiff)) = "" Then SIAr_DifferenceEntreDeuxListes = "" Else SIAr_DifferenceEntreDeuxListes = v_ListDiff End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIA, gc_Element_SIA, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function TrierArrayDocs(pand As Variant, p_fxTri As String, p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Boolean ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de trier un array de documents. ' pand = Array de NotesDocument ' p_fxTri = Formule pour déterminer la valeur utilisée pour le tri. Peut êre un nom de champ. ' -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v As Variant Dim i As Long
TrierArrayDocs = False If Isarray(pand) Then Redim a_Valeurs(Lbound(pand) To Ubound(pand)) As Variant For i = Lbound(pand) To Ubound(pand) v = Evaluate(p_fxTri, pand(i)) If Ubound(v) > 0 Then a_Valeurs(i) = Implode(v, ";") Elseif v(0) = "" Then a_Valeurs(i) = p_ValeurNulle Else a_Valeurs(i) = v(0) End If Next
TrierArrayDocs = Trier2Arrays(a_Valeurs, pand) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIa, gc_Element_SIa, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SIAr_EchangerValeurs(pa As Variant, p_PosValeur1 As Long, p_PosValeur2 As Long) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v As Variant
If Datatype(pa(p_PosValeur1)) = 35 Then Set v = pa(p_PosValeur1) Set pa(p_PosValeur1) = pa(p_PosValeur2) Set pa(p_PosValeur2) = v Else v = pa(p_PosValeur1) pa(p_PosValeur1) = pa(p_PosValeur2) pa(p_PosValeur2) = v End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIa, gc_Element_SIa, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIAr_ComparerArrays(array1 As Variant, array2 As Variant) As Boolean Dim i As Integer Dim key As String Dim tempList List As Integer
If Not Isarray(array1) Or Not Isarray(array2) Then SIAr_ComparerArrays = False Exit Function End If
If Ubound(array1) - Lbound(array1) <> Ubound(array2) - Lbound(array2) Then SIAr_ComparerArrays = False Exit Function End If
For i = Lbound(array1) To Ubound(array1) key = Typename(array1(i)) & "~" & Cstr(array1(i))
If Iselement(tempList(key)) Then ' Déjà dans la liste - incremente le compteur tempList(key) = tempList(key) + 1 Else ' pas un élément - ajouter à la liste tempList(key) = 1 End If Next
For i = Lbound(array2) To Ubound(array2) key = Typename(array2(i)) & "~" & Cstr(array2(i)) If Not Iselement(tempList(key)) Then SIAr_ComparerArrays = False Exit Function End If
tempList(key) = tempList(key) - 1 If tempList(key) = 0 Then Erase tempList(key) Next
Forall indElement In tempList SIAr_ComparerArrays = False Exit Function End Forall

Function FClie_acAttacherDocument As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Lien As String Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim nd_Clie As NotesDocument
' Initialisations '------------------- FClie_acAttacherDocument = False Call FClie_Initialisations Set ndb = xGDK_xndbNDB("SIClD")
' Créer le document de Document ' --------------------------------------------- Set nd = New NotesDocument(ndb) nd.Form = "F_Docu" nd.Docu_ClientNoFmt = xVar(gnd_FClie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") nd.Docu_ClientNom1 = xVar(gnd_FClie, "Clie_ClientNom1", "") nd.Docu_ClientNom2 = xVar(gnd_FClie, "Clie_ClientNom2", "")
' Sélectionner le Document à attacher ' -------------------------------------------------- If Not gnuiws_FClie.DialogBox("DB_Docu", True, True, False, False, False, False, _ "Attacher un document", nd, True, False, False) Then Exit Function End If
nd.Docu_NoDocument = xUnique("") nd.Cle = xVar(nd, "Docu_NoDocument", "") nd.Description = xVar(nd, "Docu_TypeDocument", "")
If xVar(nd, "Docu_Format", "") = "1" Then Set nrti = New NotesRichTextItem(nd, "Docu_Document") Call nrti.EmbedObject(EMBED_ATTACHMENT, "", xVar(nd, "Docu_Lien", "")) End If
' Sauvegarder le Document nd.HistoDC = Now nd.HistoUC = gns_FClie.Username Call nd.Save(True, False)
Call gnuiws_FClie.ViewRefresh FClie_acAttacherDocument = True Exit Function

Sub FClie_hsSelectionnerTypeSDSS '=========================================================== ' Permet de sélectionnez le type de billet pour changer la catégorie du ' EV des billets. '=========================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur

' Initialisations Call FClie_Initialisations Call xSDSS_Initialisation
Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(gndb_FClie)
' Sélectionnez le type de billet ' ---------------------------------------- If gnuiws_FClie.DialogBox( "DB_Type" , True , True , False , False , False , False , xGDK_xMessage("SDSS", 19, "", "") , nd_DB, True, False, False) Then ' v_Cle = Cstr(xVar(gnd_FClie,"Clie_ClientNoFmt","") & ";" & xVar(nd_DB,"Bill_Type","")) v_Cle = xVar(nd_DB, "Bill_Type", "*") ' Call gns_FClie.SetEnvironmentVar("SDSS_CleBill", v_Cle)
'Rafraîchir le EV des billets ' ------------------------------------ If gnuid_FClie.EditMode = True Then Call gnd_FClie.ReplaceItemValue("SDSS_CleBill_1", v_Cle) Call gnuid_FClie.Refresh Else ' Rouvrir le document en mode lecture Call gnuid_FClie.Close ' Initialise le variable d'environment (variable effacé l'ors du QueryClose) Call gns_FClie.SetEnvironmentVar("SDSS_CleBill", v_Cle) Set nuid = gnuiws_FClie.EditDocument(False, gnd_FClie) Delete gnuid_FClie Set gnuid_FClie = nuid Set gnd_FClie = gnuid_FClie.Document End If
End If Exit Sub

Sub FClie_PostOpen(p_Source As NotesUIDocument) ' Afficher les notes pour lesquelles il y a un rappel On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim s As String Dim a As Variant Dim nd_Pers As NotesDocument Dim ni_Pers As NotesItem Dim nd_DB As NotesDocument Dim i As Integer Dim v_NbNotes As Integer Dim nd_Note As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_Maj As Boolean
' Initialisations Call FClie_Initialisations Set nd = p_Source.Document v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "")
' Extraire les notes à afficher Call xSIClN_Initialisations s = Replace(|"| & gndb_xSIClN.Server & |":"| & gndb_xSIClN.FilePath & |"|, "\", "\\") a = Evaluate(|@IfError(@DbLookup(""; | & s & |; "V_Note30"; "| & _ v_ClientNoFmt & ";" & gns_FClie.Username & |"; 3); "")|) If a(0) = "" Then Exit Sub End If
Set nd_DB = New NotesDocument(nd.Parentdatabase) nd_DB.DB_ClientNoFmt = v_ClientNoFmt ' nd_DB.DB_ClientNomInterne = xVar(nd, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "")
' Extraire le profil de l'utilisateur Set nd_Pers = xndPers If Not (nd_Pers Is Nothing) Then If nd_Pers.HasItem("Pers_NoNotesCacher") Then Set ni_Pers = nd_Pers.GetFirstItem("Pers_NoNotesCacher") Else Set ni_Pers = New NotesItem(nd_Pers, "Pers_NoNotesCacher", "") End If Else Set ni_Pers = New NotesItem(nd_DB, "Pers_NoNotesCacher", "") End If
For i = Lbound(a) To Ubound(a) If Not ni_Pers.Contains(a(i)) Then v_NbNotes = v_NbNotes + 1 Set nd_Note = xSIClN_xndNote(a(i), True)
Call nd_DB.ReplaceItemValue("DB_NoNote_" & Cstr(v_NbNotes), a(i)) Call nd_DB.ReplaceItemValue("DB_Date_" & Cstr(v_NbNotes), xVar(nd_Note, "HistoDC", "")) Set nrti = nd_Note.GetFirstItem("Note_Note") Call nrti.Copyitemtodocument(nd_DB, "DB_Note_" & Cstr(v_NbNotes)) End If Next If v_NbNotes = 0 Then Exit Sub End If nd_DB.DB_NbNotes = v_NbNotes
' Afficher les notes Call gnuiws_FClie.DialogBox("DB_SIClN", True, True, True, False, False, False, xVar(nd, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") & _ " - Notes importantes", nd_DB, True, True)
' Mettre à jour les notes à ne plus afficher If Not (nd_Pers Is Nothing) Then For i = 1 To v_NbNotes If xVar(nd_DB, "DB_" & Cstr(i), "") = "1" Then s = xVar(nd_DB, "DB_NoNote_" & Cstr(i), "") If Not ni_Pers.Contains(s) Then Call ni_Pers.AppendToTextList(s) v_Maj = True End If End If Next If v_Maj Then Call nd_Pers.Save(True, False) End If End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FClie, gc_Element_FClie, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function NAB_CreerGroupe(p_Nom As String, p_Description As String, p_Categorie As String, pa_Membres As Variant) As NotesDocument '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de créer un groupe dans le carnet d'adresses du serveur Domino. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Initialisations Call NAB_Initialisations
Set nd = gndb_NAB.CreateDocument nd.Form = "Group" nd.ListName = p_Nom nd.ListDescription = p_Description nd.ListCategory = p_Categorie nd.Members = pa_Membres
' Calculer les autres items du masque Call nd.ComputeWithForm(True, False)
' Sauvegarder le nouveau groupe Call nd.Save(True, False) Set NAB_CreerGroupe = nd Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_NAB, gc_Element_NAB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function NAB_SyncroniserGroupe(p_Nom As String, p_Description As String, p_Categorie As String, pa_Membres As Variant) As Boolean '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de mettre à jour les membres d'un groupe du carnet d'adresses du serveur Domino. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Maj As Boolean
' Initialisations NAB_SyncroniserGroupe = False
' Extraire le groupe du NAB Set nd = xNAB_xndGroup(p_Nom, True)
' Si le groupe n'existe pas dans le NAB, le créer If nd Is Nothing Then Set nd = NAB_CreerGroupe(p_Nom, p_Description, p_Categorie, pa_Membres) NAB_SyncroniserGroupe = True
' Si le groupe existe dans le NAB, le mettre à jour Else If p_Description <> xVarImplode(nd, "ListDescription", ";") Then v_Maj = True Elseif p_Categorie <> xVarImplode(nd, "ListCategory", ";") Then v_Maj = True Elseif Implode(Fulltrim(pa_Membres), ";") <> xVarImplode(nd, "Members", ";") Then v_Maj = True End If ' Mettre à jour seulement si necessaire If v_Maj Then nd.ListDescription = p_Description nd.ListCategory = p_Categorie nd.Members = pa_Membres Call nd.Save(True, False) NAB_SyncroniserGroupe = True End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_NAB, gc_Element_NAB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Declare ' ********************************************************************************************* ' ***** Les fonctions qui mettent à jour les items ont été déplacées dans SI_Insertions ***** ' ********************************************************************************************* ' ' Les fonctions définies dans cette bibliothèque de script permettent d'extraire un document ou une valeur ' d'un document. Ces fonctions sont utilisées par les bibliothèques de script d'extraction (xAAA). ' ' Routines disponibles ' ' ============= ' xnd ' ============= ' Extrait un document. ' Syntaxe: call xnd(NomCle , Cle , Cache , BaseDeDocuments , NomVue , Vue, Document) ' Paramètres: NomCle String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' Cle Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ' Cache Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il ' correspond au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le ' document est relu même s'il est déjà en mémoire. ' BaseDeDocuments Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document ' sera recherché. ' NomVue String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' Vue Notesview. La vue de recherche. ' Document Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et ' que Cache contient True, le document entrant sera retourné. ' Valeurs retournées: Les paramètres suivants peuvent être modifiés par la routine: Vue et Document. ' ' ============= ' xVar ' ============= ' Extrait la valeur d'un document ' Syntaxe: flag = xVar(Document , NomVar , ValeurNulle) ' Paramètres: Document Notesdocument. Le document contenant la valeur recherchée. ' NomVar String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ValeurNulle Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas ' dans le document recherché. ' Valeur retournée: La valeur de la variable recherchée. Si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le ' document, retourne la valeur du paramètre ValeurNulle.
Dim gns_X As NotesSession Dim gndb_X As NotesDatabase Dim gnd_Prof_X As NotesDocument Dim gnd_Pers_X As NotesDocument Dim g_InitUnique_X As String

Function xVar2(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, p_NomVarValeurNulle As String, p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' p_NomVarValeurNulle contient le nom d'un item ' Permet d'éviter l'imbrication des xVar donc un gain de performance ' Ex.: xVar(nd_Empl, "Empl_LangueAffichage", "Empl_LangueLecture", "FR") Dim v_ValeurItem As Variant Dim v_ValeurNulle As Boolean
v_ValeurNulle = False
' Extraire l'item recherché v_ValeurItem = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomVar)
' Si l'item contient un tableau, c'est qu'il est défini If Isarray(v_ValeurItem) Then ' Si le tableau contient plusieurs éléments, retourner le tableau If Ubound(v_ValeurItem) > 0 Then xVar2 = v_ValeurItem ' Si l'item ne contient qu'un élément, retourner l'élément Else If Isnumeric(v_ValeurItem(0)) Then xVar2 = v_ValeurItem(0) Elseif v_ValeurItem(0) = "" Then v_ValeurNulle = True Else xVar2 = v_ValeurItem(0) End If End If ' Si l'item ne contient pas un tableau, retourne la valeur nulle Else v_ValeurNulle = True End If
If v_ValeurNulle Then If p_NomVarValeurNulle <> "" Then xVar2 = xVar(pnd, p_NomVarValeurNulle, p_ValeurNulle) Else xVar2 = p_ValeurNulle End If End If End Function

Function xVarCollectionImplode(pndc As NotesDocumentCollection, p_NomItem As String, p_Separateur As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retourner la valeur d'un champ de chaque document de la collection. ' Valeur retournée: Valeurs concaténées, séparées par le séparateur. '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim s As String
xVarCollectionImplode = "" If pndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
' Boucler sur tous les documents de la collection Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
s = xVarImplode(nd, p_NomItem, p_Separateur) If xVarCollectionImplode = "" then xVarCollectionImplode = s Else xVarCollectionImplode = xVarCollectionImplode & p_Separateur & s End If Loop End Function

Sub xnv(pndb As Notesdatabase, Byval p_NomVue As String, p_nv As Notesview) Dim ns As NotesSession
' Si la vue est déjà définie, vérifier qu'il s'agit de la bonne vue If Not (p_nv Is Nothing) Then If Isarray(p_nv.Aliases) Then If p_nv.Name <> p_NomVue And p_nv.Aliases(0) <> p_NomVue Then Set p_nv = Nothing End If Else If p_nv.Name <> p_NomVue And Cstr(p_nv.Aliases) <> p_NomVue Then Set p_nv = Nothing End If End If End If
' Si la vue n'est pas définie, initialiser la vue If p_nv Is Nothing Then If pndb Is Nothing Then Set ns = New NotesSession Set pndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set p_nv = pndb.Getview(p_NomVue) Elseif pndb.Isopen Then Set p_nv = pndb.Getview(p_NomVue) End If End If End Sub

Function xndPers As NotesDocument On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Privileges As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem
' Initialisations If gns_X Is Nothing Then Set gns_X = New NotesSession Set gndb_X = gns_X.CurrentDatabase End If Set xndPers = Nothing ' Extraire le document de profil de la base courante v_Privileges = Evaluate(|@UserAccess(@DbName; [AccessLevel])|) If v_Privileges(0) => "3" Then v_Privileges = Evaluate(|@UserAccess(@DbName; [CREATEDOCUMENTS])|) If v_Privileges(0) = "1" Then Set xndPers = gndb_X.getProfileDocument("F_Pers", gns_X.UserName) If Not xndPers.HasItem("Form") Then xndPers.Form = "F_Pers" Set ni = New NotesItem(xndPers, "Auteurs", gns_X.UserName, AUTHORS) Call ni.AppendToTextList("[Admin]") Call xndPers.Save(True, False) End If End If End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Set xndPers = Nothing If Cstr(Err()) = "4005" Then If xLangue = "EN" Then Print "Error 4005 - The version of Notes you are using is not compatible with Windows 10. Please ask technical support to update your workstation." Else Print "Erreur 4005 - La version de Notes utilisée n'est pas compatible avec Windows 10. Demandez au soutien technique de mettre à jour votre poste de travail." End If End If Exit Function End Function

Function xVersionNotes As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la version de HCL Notes
Dim a_VersionNotes(2) As String Dim v_VersionNotes As String Dim v_FP As String
If gns_X Is Nothing Then Set gns_X = New NotesSession Set gndb_X = gns_X.CurrentDatabase End If
v_VersionNotes = UCase(StrRight(gns_X.NotesVersion, " "))
If InStr(v_VersionNotes, "|") > 0 Then a_VersionNotes(2) = StrRight(v_VersionNotes, "|") v_VersionNotes = StrLeft(v_VersionNotes, "|") End If
If InStr(v_VersionNotes, "FP") > 0 Then a_VersionNotes(0) = StrLeft(v_VersionNotes, "FP") a_VersionNotes(1) = Right("00" & StrRight(v_VersionNotes, "FP"), 2) Else a_VersionNotes(0) = v_VersionNotes a_VersionNotes(1) = "00" End If
xVersionNotes = a_VersionNotes End Function

Function xVarArray(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomVar As String) As Variant Dim ni As Notesitem Dim v_ValeurItem As Variant
xVarArray = "" ' Si le document existe If Not (pnd Is Nothing) Then ' Si un l'item existe If pnd.HasItem(p_NomVar) Then ' Extraire l'item recherché v_ValeurItem = pnd.GetItemValue(p_NomVar) ' Si l'item contient un tableau If Isarray(v_ValeurItem) Then ' Si le tableau n'est pas vide, retourne le tableau If Ubound(v_ValeurItem) > Lbound(v_ValeurItem) _ Or Cstr(v_ValeurItem(Lbound(v_ValeurItem))) <> "" Then xVarArray = v_ValeurItem End If End If End If End If End Function

Function xndc(p_Cle As Variant, pndb As Notesdatabase, Byval p_NomVue As String, p_nv As Notesview) As NotesDocumentCollection
' Initialiser la vue Call xnv(pndb, p_NomVue, p_nv) If Not (p_nv Is Nothing) Then Call p_nv.Refresh
' Extraire les documents correspondant à la clé Set xndc = p_nv.Getalldocumentsbykey(p_Cle, True) Else Set xndc = pndb.CreateDocumentCollection End If End Function

Function xndcTrie(pndb As Notesdatabase, Byval p_NomVue As String, pnv As Notesview, p_Cle As Variant,p_NomItemCle As String) As NotesDocumentCollection ' Retourne une collection des documents dans l'ordre de la vue (trié) ' pndb optionnel, current database si Nothing ' p_NomVue requis si pnv is nothing ' pnv requis si p_NomVue est null ' p_Cle valeur unique seulement
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Initialiser la vue au besoin If p_NomVue <> "" Then Call xnv(pndb, p_NomVue, pnv) End If
If Not (pnv Is Nothing) Then Call pnv.Refresh
Set xndcTrie = pnv.GetAllDocumentsByKey("**BiDoN**", True)
Set nd = pnv.GetDocumentByKey(p_Cle, True) Do Until nd Is Nothing Call xndcTrie.AddDocument(nd) Set nd = pnv.GetNextDocument(nd) If xVar(nd, p_NomItemCle, "") <> p_Cle Then Set nd = Nothing End If Loop End If End Function

Function xVarImplode(pnd As NotesDocument, ByVal p_NomVar As String, ByVal p_Separateur As String) As String ' Retourne la valeur d'un item sous forme de string. Si l'item contient plusieurs valeurs, celles-ci ' sont mises bout à bout séparées par le séparateur spécifié. On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Valeur As Variant Dim i As Integer
v_Valeur = xVar(pnd, p_NomVar, "") If IsArray(v_Valeur) Then ReDim a(UBound(v_Valeur)) As String For i = 0 To UBound(v_Valeur) a(i) = CStr(v_Valeur(i)) Next xVarImplode = Implode(a, p_Separateur) Else xVarImplode = CStr(v_Valeur) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Print Error$ xVarImplode = "" Exit Function End Function

Sub xAssignerDate(pnd As NotesDocument, Byval p_NomItem As String, Byval p_Date As Variant) Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("") Dim ni As NotesItem
If pnd Is Nothing Or p_NomItem = "" Then Exit Sub End If
If Not Isdate(p_Date) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, "") Exit Sub End If
' Initialiser le notesdatetime ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Date Call ndt.Setanytime
' Supprimer les items ayant déjà une valeur Call pnd.Removeitem(p_NomItem)
' Assigner la nouvelle valeur Set ni = New NotesItem(pnd, p_NomItem, "") ni.IsSummary = True Set ni.DateTimeValue = ndt End Sub

Function xParamQueryStringOpt(pnd As NotesDocument, p_Param As String, p_Decoded As Boolean) As String
Dim value As String
If p_Decoded Then value = xVar(pnd,"QUERY_STRING_DECODED","") Else value = xVar(pnd,"query_String","") End If
xParamQueryStringOpt = xParamQueryStringQS(value, p_Param) End Function

Function xndListElem(p_Liste As Variant, p_NomElement As String) As NotesDocument Set xndListElem = Nothing
If Iselement(p_Liste(p_NomElement)) Then Set xndListElem = p_Liste(p_NomElement) End If End Function

Function xUnique(p_UserName As String) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
' 2021-03-02 PBE - Ajouté les initiales de l'utilisateur ' 2021-04-20 PJU - Remplacer les caractères accentués
Dim a_Unique As Variant Dim a_NomUtilisateur As Variant Dim v_User As String Dim v_Unique As string
Const ACC_CHARS = "Š,Ž,Ÿ,À,Á,Â,Ã,Ä,Å,Ç,È,É,Ê,Ë,Ì,Í,Î,Ï,Ð,Ñ,Ò,Ó,Ô,Õ,Ö,Ù,Ú,Û,Ü,Ý" Const REG_CHARS = "S,Z,Y,A,A,A,A,A,A,C,E,E,E,E,I,I,I,I,D,N,O,O,O,O,O,U,U,U,U,Y"
a_Unique = Evaluate(|@Right(@Unique; 6)|)
If g_InitUnique_X = "" Then If p_UserName = "" Then a_NomUtilisateur = Evaluate(|@Explode(@Name([CN]; @UserName); " ")|) Else a_NomUtilisateur = Evaluate(|@Explode(@Name([CN]; "| & p_UserName & |"); " ")|) End If g_InitUnique_X = UCase(Left(a_NomUtilisateur(LBound(a_NomUtilisateur)), 1) & Left(a_NomUtilisateur(uBound(a_NomUtilisateur)), 2)) End If
v_Unique = a_Unique(0) & Replace(g_InitUnique_X, Split(ACC_CHARS, ","), Split(REG_CHARS, ",")) xUnique = v_Unique Exit Function
GererErreur: xUnique = a_Unique(0) Exit Function End Function

Function xVarProf(Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant Dim v_ValeurItem As Variant
' Initialisations Call xndProf
' Extraire l'item recherché v_ValeurItem = xVarArray(gnd_Prof_X, p_NomVar)
' Si l'item contient un tableau, c'est qu'il est défini If Isarray(v_ValeurItem) Then ' Si le tableau contient plusieurs éléments, retourner le tableau If Ubound(v_ValeurItem) > 0 Then xVarProf = v_ValeurItem ' Si l'item ne contient qu'un élément, retourner l'élément Else If Isnumeric(v_ValeurItem(0)) Then xVarProf = v_ValeurItem(0) Elseif v_ValeurItem(0) = "" Then xVarProf = p_ValeurNulle Else xVarProf = v_ValeurItem(0) End If End If ' Si l'item ne contient pas un tableau, retourne la valeur nulle Else xVarProf = p_ValeurNulle End If End Function

Function xParamQueryString(pnd As NotesDocument, p_Param As String) As String

value = xVar(pnd,"query_String","")
xParamQueryString = xParamQueryStringQS(value, p_Param) End Function

Function xEvalSearch(pndb As NotesDatabase, p_fxSearch As String, p_fxValeur As String) As Variant ' Retourne la valeur d'un item sous forme de string. Si l'item contient plusieurs valeurs, celles-çi ' son mises bout à bout séparées par le séparateur spécifié. On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim i As Long Dim v As Variant
xEvalSearch = ""
Set ndc = pndb.Search(p_fxSearch, Nothing, 0) If ndc.Count > 0 Then Redim a(ndc.Count - 1) As Variant i = -1
Set nd = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing v = Evaluate(p_fxValeur, nd) i = i + 1 If Ubound(v) > 0 Then a(i) = v Else a(i) = v(0) End If
Set nd = ndc.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop
xEvalSearch = a End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Exit Function End Function

Function xEvaluate(p_Formule As Variant, pnd As NotesDocument) As Variant ' VOIR aussi SINF_Evaluate dans le script library SL_NotesFormula Dim v_valeur As Variant
If pnd Is Nothing Then v_valeur = Evaluate(p_Formule) Else v_valeur = Evaluate(p_Formule, pnd) End If
If Isarray(v_valeur) Then xEvaluate = v_valeur(0) Else xEvaluate = "" End If End Function

Function xVarCollection(pndc As NotesDocumentCollection, p_NomItem As String) As Variant '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retourner la valeur d'un champ de chaque document de la collection. ' Valeur retournée: Array des valeurs '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Redim a(99) As String Dim i As Integer Dim s As String
If pndc.Count = 0 Then xVarCollection = "" Exit Function End If i = -1
' Boucler sur tous les documents de la collection Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = pndc.GetNextDocument(nd_Suivant)
s = CStr(xVarElem(nd, p_NomItem, 0, "")) If s <> "" Then i = i + 1 If i > UBound(a) Then ReDim Preserve a(i + 100) As String End If
a(i) = s End If Loop
If i >= 0 Then ReDim Preserve a(i) As String xVarCollection = a Else xVarCollection = "" End If End Function

Function xniElem(pni As Notesitem, Byval p_Elem As Long, _ Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' Permet d'extraire un élément d'un NotesItem
If pni Is Nothing Then xniElem = p_ValeurNulle Elseif p_Elem < Lbound(pni.Values) Or p_Elem > Ubound(pni.Values) Then xniElem = p_ValeurNulle Elseif Isnumeric(pni.Values(p_Elem)) Then xniElem = pni.Values(p_Elem) Elseif pni.Values(p_Elem) = "" Then xniElem = p_ValeurNulle Else xniElem = pni.Values(p_Elem) End If End Function

Sub xndUNID(p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer, pndb As Notesdatabase, pnd As Notesdocument) On Error 4091 Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Relire As Integer
' Si on n'utilise pas la cache, il faut lire le document If p_Cache = False Then v_Relire = True ' Si on la cache ne contient pas de document, il faut lire le document Elseif pnd Is Nothing Then v_Relire = True ' Si le document en cache n'est pas le document recherché, il faut lire le document Elseif Cstr(p_Cle) <> Cstr(pnd.UniversalID) Then v_Relire = True End If
' Chargement du document dans la cache If v_Relire Then Set pnd = Nothing
' Extraire le document correspondant à la clé Set pnd = pndb.GetdocumentbyUNID(p_Cle) End If
Exit Sub GererErreur: Set pnd = Nothing Exit Sub End Sub

Function xVarElem(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, _ Byval p_Elem As Long, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant Dim v_ValeurItem As Variant
' Extraire l'item recherché v_ValeurItem = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomVar)
' Si l'item contient un tableau, c'est qu'il est défini If Isarray(v_ValeurItem) Then ' Si le tableau contient l'élément recherché, retourner l'élément If p_Elem >= Lbound(v_ValeurItem) And p_Elem <= Ubound(v_ValeurItem) Then If Isnumeric(v_ValeurItem(p_Elem)) Then xVarElem = v_ValeurItem(p_Elem) Elseif v_ValeurItem(p_Elem) = "" Then xVarElem = p_ValeurNulle Else xVarElem = v_ValeurItem(p_Elem) End If Else xVarElem = p_ValeurNulle End If ' Si l'item ne contient pas un tableau, retourne la valeur nulle Else xVarElem = p_ValeurNulle End If End Function

Function xndProf As NotesDocument If gnd_Prof_X Is Nothing Then If gns_X Is Nothing Then Set gns_X = New NotesSession Set gndb_X = gns_X.CurrentDatabase End If
' Extraire le document de profil de la base courante Set gnd_Prof_X = gndb_X.getProfileDocument("F_Prof") End If
Set xndProf = gnd_Prof_X End Function

Sub xnd(Byval p_NomCle As String, p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer, pndb As Notesdatabase, _ Byval p_NomVue As String, p_nv As Notesview, pnd As Notesdocument) Dim v_Relire As Integer Dim v_ValeurItem As Variant
' Si on n'utilise pas la cache, il faut lire le document If p_Cache = False Then v_Relire = True ' Si on la cache ne contient pas de document, il faut lire le document Elseif pnd Is Nothing Then v_Relire = True ' Si le nom de la clé n'est pas spécifié, il faut lire le document Elseif p_NomCle = "" Then v_Relire = True ' Si le document en cache ne contient pas la clé, il faut lire le document Elseif Not pnd.Hasitem(p_NomCle) Then v_Relire = True Else ' Si le document en cache contient une clé invalide, il faut lire le document v_ValeurItem = pnd.Getitemvalue(p_NomCle) If Not Isarray(v_ValeurItem) Then v_Relire = True ' Si la clé du document en cache n'est pas la clé recherchée, il faut lire le document Elseif Cstr(p_Cle) <> Cstr(v_ValeurItem(0)) Then v_Relire = True ' Dans les autres cas, on peut réutiliser le document de la cache Else v_Relire = False End If End If
' Chargement du document dans la cache If v_Relire Then Set pnd = Nothing
' Initialiser la vue Call xnv(pndb, p_NomVue, p_nv) If Not (p_nv Is Nothing) Then Call p_nv.Refresh
' Extraire le document correspondant à la clé Set pnd = p_nv.Getdocumentbykey(p_Cle, True) End If End If End Sub

Function xLangue As String ' Cette fonction retourne la langue de l'utilisateur Dim v_Langue As Variant
xLangue = "FR"
v_Langue = Evaluate("@UpperCase(@Left(@LanguagePreference([CONTENT]); 2))") If Isarray(v_Langue) Then If v_Langue(0) = "EN" Then xLangue = "EN" End If End If End Function

Function xVarContient(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, p_Valeur As Variant) As Boolean Dim ni As Notesitem Dim v_ValeurItem As Variant ' Permet de savoir si un item contient la valeur recherchée
xVarContient = False ' Si le document existe If Not (pnd Is Nothing) Then ' Si un l'item existe If pnd.HasItem(p_NomVar) Then ' Extraire l'item recherché Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Si l'item contient la valeur recherchée If ni.Contains(p_Valeur) Then xVarContient = True End If End If End If End Function

Function xVarPers(Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_ValeurItem As Variant
xVarPers = p_ValeurNulle
Set nd = xndPers If nd Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
' Extraire l'item recherché v_ValeurItem = xVarArray(nd, p_NomVar)
' Si l'item contient un tableau, c'est qu'il est défini If Isarray(v_ValeurItem) Then ' Si le tableau contient plusieurs éléments, retourner le tableau If Ubound(v_ValeurItem) > 0 Then xVarPers = v_ValeurItem ' Si l'item ne contient qu'un élément, retourner l'élément Else If Isnumeric(v_ValeurItem(0)) Then xVarPers = v_ValeurItem(0) Elseif v_ValeurItem(0) <> "" Then xVarPers = p_ValeurNulle End If End If End If End Function

Function xni(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurDefaut As Variant) As NotesItem ' Si le document existe If Not (pnd Is Nothing) Then ' Si l'item existe If pnd.HasItem(p_NomVar) Then Set xni = pnd.GetFirstItem(p_NomVar) ' Si l'item n'existe pas, le créer Else Set xni = New NotesItem(pnd, p_NomVar, p_ValeurDefaut) xni.IsSummary = True End If End If End Function

Function xVar(pnd As Notesdocument, Byval p_NomVar As String, p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant Dim v_ValeurItem As Variant
' Extraire l'item recherché v_ValeurItem = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomVar)
' Si l'item contient un tableau, c'est qu'il est défini If Isarray(v_ValeurItem) Then ' Si le tableau contient plusieurs éléments, retourner le tableau If Ubound(v_ValeurItem) > 0 Then xVar = v_ValeurItem ' Si l'item ne contient qu'un élément, retourner l'élément Else If Isnumeric(v_ValeurItem(0)) Then xVar = v_ValeurItem(0) Elseif v_ValeurItem(0) = "" Then xVar = p_ValeurNulle Else xVar = v_ValeurItem(0) End If End If ' Si l'item ne contient pas un tableau, retourne la valeur nulle Else xVar = p_ValeurNulle End If End Function

Function xListElem(p_Liste As Variant, p_NomElement As String, p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant
xListElem = ""
If Iselement(p_Liste(p_NomElement)) Then xListElem = p_Liste(p_NomElement) End If End Function

Function xParamQueryStringQS(p_QueryString As String, p_Param As String) As String
Dim value As String Dim index As Integer
value = p_QueryString index = InStr(1, value, "&" + p_Param + "=", 1)
If index = 0 Then value = "" Else value = Mid$(value, index + Len(p_Param) + 2) index = InStr(value, "&") If index > 0 Then value = Left$(value, index - 1) End If End If
xParamQueryStringQS = value End Function

Function SIPJ_AjouterNote(p_NomDB As String, pnd_Parent As notesdocument, p_Type As String, p_Description As String, p_Date As Variant, _ p_Utilisateur As String) As Boolean %REM ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Le script permet de créer une note dans la base de documents du document parent Paramètres: pnd_Parent NotesDocument. Obligatoire. Le document parent. La note est créer dans la base de documents du document parent. p_Type String. Le type de note (Interne ou Externe). Initialisé à Interne si null. p_Description String. Obligatoire. La description sommaire du note. p_Date Variant. La date pour l'historique. Initialisé à Now si null. p_Utilisateur String. Le ID du représantant pour l'historique. Initialisé à NotesSession.Username si null. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ %END REM On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Note As NotesDocument
' Validations SIPJ_AjouterNote = False If pnd_Parent Is Nothing Or p_Description = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Initialisations Call SIPJ_Initialisations(p_NomDB)
' Créer le nouveau document Set nd_Note = New NotesDocument(pnd_Parent.ParentDatabase) nd_Note.Form = "F_Note"
' Copier l'information du parent Call SIPJ_CreerLiaison(pnd_Parent, nd_Note)
' Ajouter l'information spécifique nd_Note.Note_Desc = p_Description nd_Note.Description = p_Description If Len(p_Type) = 0 Then nd_Note.Note_Type = "Interne" Else nd_Note.Note_Type = p_Type End If If Len(p_Date) = 0 Then nd_Note.HistoDC = Now Else nd_Note.HistoDC = p_Date End If If Len(p_Utilisateur) = 0 Then nd_Note.HistoUC = gns_SIPJ.Username Else nd_Note.HistoUC = p_Utilisateur End If
' Sauvegarder le document Call nd_Note.MakeResponse(pnd_Parent) Call nd_Note.Save(True, False)
SIPJ_AjouterNote = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIPJ, gc_Element_SIPJ, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIPJ_AssignerEtape(p_NomDB As String, pnd_Proj As NotesDocument, p_Etape As String) As Boolean '================================================================================ ' Fonction qui gére tout les calculs et les modifications relatifs à l'étape sélectionnée '================================================================================ On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_EtapeNum As Integer Dim v_DescEtapeFR As String Dim v_DescEtapeEN As String Dim a_Evolution As Variant Dim a_EvolutionFR As Variant Dim a_EvolutionEN As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_Ponderation As Double ' Initialisations SIPJ_AssignerEtape = False
' Initialisations If Not SIPJ_Initialisations(p_NomDB) Then Exit Function End If
' Vérification de l'étape sélectionnée '-------------------------------------------------------- If p_Etape <> xVar(pnd_Proj, "Proj_DerniereEtape", "") Then v_EtapeNum = Cint(p_Etape) v_DescEtapeFR = xPJ_xDescTabl(p_NomDB, p_Etape, "ÉtapesFR", True) v_DescEtapeEN = xPJ_xDescTabl(p_NomDB, p_Etape, "ÉtapesEN", True)
'Changement d'étape pnd_Proj.Proj_Etape = p_Etape pnd_Proj.Proj_DerniereEtape = p_Etape pnd_Proj.Proj_DerniereEtapeFR = v_DescEtapeFR pnd_Proj.Proj_DerniereEtapeEN = v_DescEtapeEN pnd_Proj.Proj_Pourcent = v_EtapeNum
'Évolution du projet a_Evolution = xVarArray(pnd_Proj, "Proj_Status_Choix") a_EvolutionFR = xVarArray(pnd_Proj, "Proj_Status_ChoixFR") a_EvolutionEN = xVarArray(pnd_Proj, "Proj_Status_ChoixEN")
Call pnd_Proj.ReplaceItemValue("Proj_Status_Choix", p_Etape) Call pnd_Proj.ReplaceItemValue("Proj_Status_ChoixFR", v_DescEtapeFR) Call pnd_Proj.ReplaceItemValue("Proj_Status_ChoixEN", v_DescEtapeEN) If Isarray(a_Evolution) Then Set ni = pnd_Proj.GetFirstItem("Proj_Status_Choix") Call ni.AppendToTextList(a_Evolution) If Isarray(a_EvolutionFR) Then Set ni = pnd_Proj.GetFirstItem("Proj_Status_ChoixFR") Call ni.AppendToTextList(a_EvolutionFR) End If If Isarray(a_EvolutionEN) Then Set ni = pnd_Proj.GetFirstItem("Proj_Status_ChoixEN") Call ni.AppendToTextList(a_EvolutionEN) End If End If
'Calcul des montants pondérés If v_EtapeNum < 50 Then v_Ponderation = 0 Elseif v_EtapeNum < 75 Then v_Ponderation = .25 Elseif v_EtapeNum < 90 Then v_Ponderation = .5 Elseif v_EtapeNum < 100 Then v_Ponderation = .75 Else v_Ponderation = 1 End If
pnd_Proj.Proj_TotalPond = xVar(pnd_Proj, "Proj_Total", 0) * v_Ponderation pnd_Proj.Proj_ProfitPond = xVar(pnd_Proj, "Proj_Montant_4", 0) * v_Ponderation
SIPJ_AssignerEtape = True End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIPJ, gc_Element_SIPJ, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

function SIPJ_NomDB(p_Département As String) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Select Case p_Département Case "60" SIPJ_NomDB = "PJSDS" Case "62" SIPJ_NomDB = "PJUSA" Case Else SIPJ_NomDB = "PJDIV" End Select
Exit function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIPJ, gc_Element_SIPJ, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit function End Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Extractions" Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_AAAA" ou "AAAA" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "AAAA" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Clie" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

Dim v_NomBD_xPJ As String ' Nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK.
' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xPJ As Notesdatabase
