Sub A_TraiterGroupes ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Ce script génère les groupes de client ' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_NbClients As Integer Dim v_Formule As String Dim ndc_Groupes As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Collection As NotesDocument Dim v_PrefixeClient As String Dim v_PrefixeClientSuivant As String Dim nd_GCli As NotesDocument Dim v_NoDepartement As Integer Dim a_NomGroupeClient As Variant Dim v_NomGroupeClient As String Dim v_NomGroupeClient1er As String Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim ni As NotesItem
' Initialisations v_NbClients = 0
' Mettre tous les groupes de clients dans une collection v_Formule = |Form = "F_GCli"| Set ndc_Groupes = gndb_A.Search(v_Formule, Nothing, 0)
' Boucler sur les clients actifs Set nv = gndb_A.Getview("V_Clie10") ' Vue des clients actifs Call nv.Refresh Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument v_NomGroupeClient1er = xVar(nd_Suivant, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") ' Valeur par défaut Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
v_NbClients = v_NbClients + 1
v_PrefixeClient = Strleftback(xVar(nd, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", ""), "-") v_PrefixeClientSuivant = Strleftback(xVar(nd_Suivant, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", ""), "-")
' Si le préfixe est différent du suivant If v_PrefixeClient <> v_PrefixeClientSuivant Or nd_Suivant Is Nothing Then
If v_NbClients > 1 Then ' Extraire le groupe Set nd_GCli = xSICl_xndGCli(Clng(v_PrefixeClient), False)
If nd_GCli Is Nothing Then ' Si le groupe n'existe pas, le créer ' Extraire le nom du groupe de Projeto v_NoDepartement = xVar(nd, "Clie_ClientCategorie", 0) Call xPJ_Initialisations(SIPJ_NomDB(Cstr(v_NoDepartement)))
v_Formule = |@Unique(@Trim(@DbLookup("" : "NoCache"; "| & gndb_xPJ.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xPJ.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_Clie3"; "| & v_PrefixeClient & |-"; 3; [PARTIALMATCH]:[FAILSILENT])))| a_NomGroupeClient= Evaluate(v_Formule) If a_NomGroupeClient(0) = "" Then v_NomGroupeClient = v_NomGroupeClient1er v_NomGroupeClient1er = xVar(nd, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") ' Valeur par défaut Else v_NomGroupeClient = a_NomGroupeClient(0) End If
' Créer le nouveau groupe Set nd_GCli = New NotesDocument(gndb_A) nd_GCli.Form = "F_GCli" nd_GCli.Cle = v_PrefixeClient nd_GCli.Description = v_NomGroupeClient nd_GCli.GCli_NoGroupe = Clng(v_PrefixeClient) nd_GCli.GCli_NomGroupe = v_NomGroupeClient nd_GCli.GCli_NoDepartement = v_NoDepartement nd_GCli.HistoDC = Now nd_GCli.HustoUC = gns_A.UserName Set ni = New NotesItem(nd_GCli, "Auteurs", "[Admin]", AUTHORS) Call ni.AppendToTextList("[Base]") Call ni.AppendToTextList("[Groupes]") v_Maj = True Else ' Enlever le groupe de la collection Set nd_Collection = ndc_Groupes.GetDocument(nd_GCli) Call ndc_Groupes.DeleteDocument(nd_Collection) End If
If Not (nd_GCli Is Nothing) Then v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(nd_GCli, "GCli_NbSites", v_NbClients, False) Or v_Maj
If v_Maj Then Call nd_GCli.Save(True, False) End If End If End if
v_NbClients = 0 v_NomGroupeClient1er = xVar(nd_Suivant, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") ' Valeur par défaut v_Maj = False End If Loop
' Envoyer la collection dans la corbeille If ndc_Groupes.Count >= 1 Then Call SIDS_CorbeilleDocumentCollection(ndc_Groupes, xUnique(""), gc_Element_A, "") End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), v_PrefixeClient, False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function A_TraiterCS(pnd_Clie As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim l_ValeursContrat List As Variant
Dim v_Contrat As Variant
A_TraiterCS = False
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "")
If SDSCS_ExtraireContratService(v_ClientNoFmt, l_ValeursContrat) Then If l_ValeursContrat("Statut") < "50" Then A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWin", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWeb", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "CSA_Statut", "4", False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "CSA_Suspendu", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDS", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDSIcone", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS Else If l_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") <> "" Then A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDS", l_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDS") , False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDSIcone", xGDK_xCompTabl(l_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDS"), "SDS_TypeInstallation", "1", True) , False) Or A_TraiterCS Elseif l_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") <> "" Then A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDS", l_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDSMerlin") , False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDSIcone", xGDK_xCompTabl(l_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDSMerlin"), "SDS_TypeInstallation", "1", True) , False) Or A_TraiterCS End If
A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWin", l_ValeursContrat("SDSWin"), False) Or A_TraiterCS If Not isarray(l_ValeursContrat("ClesModules")) Then A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWeb", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS elseIf IsNull(ArrayGetIndex(l_ValeursContrat("ClesModules"), "0012558")) And IsNull(ArrayGetIndex(l_ValeursContrat("ClesModules"), "0012562")) then A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWeb", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS else A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWeb", "1", False) Or A_TraiterCS End if If l_ValeursContrat("Suspendu") = "1" Then A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "CSA_Statut", "2", False) Or A_TraiterCS Else A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "CSA_Statut", "1", False) Or A_TraiterCS End If End If Else A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWin", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWeb", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS If xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_DateInstallation", Today + 1) > Today Then A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "CSA_Statut", "4", False) Or A_TraiterCS Else A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "CSA_Statut", "0", False) Or A_TraiterCS End If A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "CSA_Suspendu", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDS", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS A_TraiterCS = SIIx_MajItem(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDSIcone", "", False) Or A_TraiterCS End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub A_TraiterEquipments(pnd_Clie As NotesDocument) ' met les équipments pour ce client (pCle) inactif On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc_SICf As NotesDocumentCollection Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String
If gnv_Equi70_A Is Nothing Then Set gnv_Equi70_A = gndb_xSICf.Getview("V_Equi70") End If
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd_Clie, "Equi_ClientNoFmt", "") Set ndc_SICf = gnv_Equi70_A.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_ClientNoFmt,True) If Not (ndc_SICf Is Nothing) Then If ndc_SICf.Count > 0 Then Call ndc_SICf.StampAll("Equi_Inactif","1") End If End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub
End Sub

Function A_TraiterSDS(pnd_Clie As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
A_TraiterSDS = False
Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") Set nd_SDS = xSICf_xndSDS(v_ClientNoFmt, False) If Not nd_SDS Is Nothing Then ' Ajouter / maj les champs, si nécessaire A_TraiterSDS = A_AjouterSDS(pnd_Clie, nd_SDS)
' Ajouter indicateur pour workflow If A_TraiterSDS Then nd_SDS.SDS_SDSWF = "1" Call nd_SDS.Save(True, False) End If
Else ' Enlever les champs, si necessaire A_TraiterSDS = A_SupprimerSDS(pnd_Clie) End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function A_SupprimerSDS(pnd_Clie As NotesDocument) As Boolean
On Error Goto GererErreur
A_SupprimerSDS = False

Sub A_TraiterClients On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Clie As NotesView Dim nd_Clie As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument
Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long Dim v_Sauvegarder As Boolean Dim nd_VPN_Merl As NotesDocument
Print "Début" Call xSICf_Initialisation Call xSICo_Initialisation
' Initialisations Set nv_Clie = gndb_A.GetView("V_Clie20") Set nd_Suivant = nv_Clie.GetFirstDocument
Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd_Clie = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv_Clie.GetNextDocument(nd_Clie) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
v_Sauvegarder = False
' *** SI ACTIF If xVar(nd_Clie,"Clie_ClientCodeAct","") = 1 Then ' 1 = Actif; 0 = Inactif
' Traiter les clients SDS If A_TraiterSDS(nd_Clie) Then v_Sauvegarder = True End If
' Traiter les clients Merlin If A_TraiterMerlin(nd_Clie) Then v_Sauvegarder = True End If
' Traiter les documents VPNs - SDS If A_TraiterVPN_SDS(nd_Clie) Then v_Sauvegarder = True End If
' Traiter les documents VPNs - Merlin If A_TraiterVPN_Merl(nd_Clie, nd_VPN_Merl) Then v_Sauvegarder = True End If
' Traiter les documents LogMeIn If A_TraiterLogMeIn(nd_Clie, nd_VPN_Merl) Then v_Sauvegarder = True End If
' Traiter les CS If A_TraiterCS(nd_Clie) Then v_Sauvegarder = True End If
' Initialiser la sécurité If A_Securite(nd_Clie) Then v_Sauvegarder = True End If
' Mise a jour champ de recherche v_Sauvegarder = SIIx_MajItem(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNomInterneRech", SItS_RemplacerAccents(xVar(nd_Clie,"Clie_ClientNomInterne","")), False) Or v_Sauvegarder
v_Sauvegarder = SIIx_MajItem(nd_Clie, "Clie_NomGroupeClients", _ xSICl_xVarGCli(xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNo1", 0), "GCli_NomGroupe", "", True), False) Or v_Sauvegarder End If
' Sauvegarde, si necessaire If v_Sauvegarder Then Call nd_Clie.Save( True, False) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If Loop
Print "Fin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus)
Exit Sub

Function A_AjouterSDS(pnd_Clie As NotesDocument, pnd_SDS As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim s As String Dim nd_Serv As notesdocument Dim l_ValeursContrat List As Variant
A_AjouterSDS = False
If xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_Icone", 0) <> xVar(pnd_SDS, "Conf_Icone", 0) Then pnd_Clie.SDS_Icone = xVar(pnd_SDS, "Conf_Icone", 0) A_AjouterSDS = True End If
If xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_VersionSDS", "") <> xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_VersionSDS", "") Then pnd_Clie.SDS_VersionSDS = xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_VersionSDS", "") A_AjouterSDS = True End If
If xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_DateInstallation", "") <> xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_DateInstallation", "") Then pnd_Clie.SDS_DateInstallation = xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_DateInstallation", "") A_AjouterSDS = True End If
If xVarImplode(pnd_Clie, "SDS_Bannieres", ";") <> xVarImplode( pnd_SDS, "SDS_Bannieres", ";") Then pnd_Clie.SDS_Bannieres = xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_Bannieres", "") pnd_Clie.SDS_BannieresDesc = xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_BannieresDesc", "") A_AjouterSDS = True End If
If xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_Line", "") <> xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_Line", "") Then pnd_Clie.SDS_Line = xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_Line", "") A_AjouterSDS = True End If
If xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_F", "") <> xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_F", "") Then pnd_Clie.SDS_F = xVar( pnd_SDS, "SDS_F", "") A_AjouterSDS = True End If
s = xSICo_xVarCont(xVar(pnd_SDS, "SDS_NoContact", ""), "Cont_ContactTelephone1Fmt", xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_ClientTelephone1", ""), True) If xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_ContactPhone", "") <> s Then pnd_Clie.SDS_ContactPhone = s A_AjouterSDS = True End If
s = xVar(pnd_SDS, "SDS_NoConfigurationServeur", "") Set nd_Serv = xSICf_xndServ(s,False)
s = xVar( nd_Serv, "Serv_NomServeur", "") If Cstr(xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_NomServeur", "")) <> s Then pnd_Clie.SDS_NomServeur = s A_AjouterSDS = True End If
s = "" If Not nd_Serv Is Nothing Then If xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") = xVar( nd_Serv, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", "") Then s = "AS/400" End If End If If Cstr(xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_Systeme", "")) <> s Then pnd_Clie.SDS_Systeme = s A_AjouterSDS = True End If
s = xVar( nd_Serv, "Serv_VersionOS", "") If Cstr(xVar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_VersionOS", "")) <> s Then pnd_Clie.SDS_VersionOS = s A_AjouterSDS = True End If
' Serveur hébergé ou sur site '------------------------------ s = xVar( nd_Serv, "Serv_TypeInstallation", "0") If xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeInstallationSDS", "") <> s Then pnd_Clie.Clie_TypeInstallationSDS = s A_AjouterSDS = True End If
If s = "0" Then If SDSCS_ExtraireContratService(xVar(nd_Serv, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", ""), l_ValeursContrat) Then If l_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "1" Then s = "2" End If End If End If If s = "2" Then s = "190" ' Nuage bleu Else s = xGDK_xIcnTabl(xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeInstallationSDS", "") , "SDS_TypeInstallation", True) End If If Cstr(xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeInstallationSDSIcone", "")) <> s Then pnd_Clie.Clie_TypeInstallationSDSIcone = Cint(s) A_AjouterSDS = True End If
Exit Function

A_TraiterLogMeIn = False

Function A_TraiterMerlin(pnd_Clie As NotesDocument) As Boolean
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_Merl As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim s As String Dim nd_Serv As NotesDocument Dim l_ValeursContrat List As Variant Dim nd_SDS As NotesDocument
A_TraiterMerlin = False
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "")
' modifier l'info Merlin, si necessaire Set nd_Merl = xSICf_xndMerl(v_ClientNoFmt, True) If Not (nd_Merl Is Nothing) Then If xVar( pnd_Clie, "Merl_Icone", 0) <> xVar( nd_Merl, "Conf_Icone", 0) Then pnd_Clie.Merl_Icone = xVar( nd_Merl, "Conf_Icone", 0) A_TraiterMerlin = True End If
If xVar( pnd_Clie, "Merl_VersionMerl", "") <> xVar( nd_Merl, "Merl_DescVersionMerlin", "") Then pnd_Clie.Merl_VersionMerl = xVar( nd_Merl, "Merl_DescVersionMerlin", "") A_TraiterMerlin = True End If
' serveur hébergé ou sur site '------------------------------ If xvar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_Icone", 0) = 0 Then s = xVar(nd_Merl, "Merl_NoConfigurationServeur", "") Set nd_Serv = xSICf_xndServ(s, False)
s = xVar( nd_Serv, "Serv_TypeInstallation", "0") If xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeInstallationSDS", "") <> s Then pnd_Clie.Clie_TypeInstallationSDS = s A_TraiterMerlin = True End If
If s = "0" Then If SDSCS_ExtraireContratService(xVar(nd_Serv, "Conf_ClientNoFmt", ""), l_ValeursContrat) Then If l_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDSMerlin") = "1" Then s = "2" End If End If End If If s = "2" Then s = "190" ' Nuage bleu Else s = xGDK_xIcnTabl(xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeInstallationSDS", "") , "SDS_TypeInstallation", True) End If If Cstr(xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_TypeInstallationSDSIcone", "")) <> s Then pnd_Clie.Clie_TypeInstallationSDSIcone = Cint(s) A_TraiterMerlin = True End If End If
' Bannière, si le client SDS n'existe pas prendre la bannière dans Merlin Set nd_SDS = xSICf_xndSDS(v_ClientNoFmt, False) If nd_SDS Is Nothing Then pnd_Clie.Merl_Bannieres = xVar(nd_Merl, "Merl_Bannieres", "") pnd_Clie.Merl_BannieresDesc = xVar(nd_Merl, "Merl_BannieresDesc", "") A_TraiterMerlin = True End If
' Supprimer, si necessaire Elseif xVar(pnd_Clie, "Merl_Icone", "") <> "" Then Call pnd_Clie.RemoveItem("Merl_Icone") Call pnd_Clie.RemoveItem("Merl_VersionMerl") If xvar(pnd_Clie, "SDS_Icone", 0) = 0 Then Call pnd_Clie.RemoveItem("Clie_TypeInstallationSDS") Call pnd_Clie.RemoveItem("Clie_TypeInstallationSDSIcone") End If
A_TraiterMerlin = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function A_Securite(pnd_Clie As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Categorie As String Dim a_Lecteurs(2) As String Dim a_Auteurs(2) As String Dim ni As NotesItem
A_Securite = False v_Categorie = xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_ClientCategorie", "0")
a_Lecteurs(0) = "[Admin]" a_Lecteurs(1) = "[catTous]" a_Lecteurs(2) = "[cat" & Right("0" & v_Categorie, 2) & "]" Set ni = pnd_Clie.GetFirstItem("Lecteurs") If ni Is Nothing Then Set ni = New NotesItem(pnd_Clie, "Lecteurs", a_Lecteurs, READERS) A_Securite = True Elseif Ubound(ni.Values) <> 2 Then ni.Values = a_Lecteurs A_Securite = True Elseif a_Lecteurs(0) <> ni.Values(0) Or a_Lecteurs(1) <> ni.Values(1) Or a_Lecteurs(2) <> ni.Values(2) Then ni.Values = a_Lecteurs A_Securite = True End If
a_Auteurs(0) = "[Admin]" a_Auteurs(1) = "[autTous]" a_Auteurs(2) = "[aut" & Right("0" & v_Categorie, 2) & "]" Set ni = pnd_Clie.GetFirstItem("Auteurs") If ni Is Nothing Then Set ni = New NotesItem(pnd_Clie, "Auteurs", a_Auteurs, AUTHORS) A_Securite = True Elseif Ubound(ni.Values) <> 2 Then ni.Values = a_Auteurs A_Securite = True Elseif a_Auteurs(0) <> ni.Values(0) Or a_Auteurs(1) <> ni.Values(1) Or a_Auteurs(2) <> ni.Values(2) Then ni.Values = a_Auteurs A_Securite = True End If Exit Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SINF = "SL" Const gc_Element_SINF = "SI_NotesFormula"
' Based on « Validating a Notes formula from LotusScript » submitted to the ' SearchDomino.com tip exchange by member Christian Cloutier
Const NULLHANDLE = 0 Const NO_ERROR = 0 Const ERR_FORMULA_COMPILATION = &h500 + 1
Declare Function NSFFormulaCompile Lib "nnotes.dll" ( _ ByVal FormulaName As Long, _ ByVal FormulaNameLength As Integer, _ ByVal FormulaText As LMBCS String, _ ByVal FormulaTextLength As Integer, _ rethFormula As Long, _ retFormulaLength As Integer, _ retCompileError As Integer, _ retCompileErrorLine As Integer, _ retCompileErrorColumn As Integer, _ retCompileErrorOffset As Integer, _ retCompileErrorLength As Integer _ ) As Integer
Declare Sub OSMemFree Lib "nnotes.dll"(ByVal hHandle As Long)
Declare Function OSLoadString Lib "nnotes.dll" ( _ ByVal hmodule As Long, _ ByVal status As Integer, _ ByVal s As String, _ ByVal slen As Integer _ ) As Integer

Sub Terminate
End Sub

Function SINF_ValiderFormule(p_Formule As String, p_Erreur As String) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur ' ================================================================================ ' SINF_ValiderFormule - This function uses the Lotus C API To Return a Notes error's Text message. ' ' Return Value: True if formula is valid, False in an error was found ' p_Erreur - The text associated With the Notes API Error code, including the error offset. ' ================================================================================ Dim a_Resultat As Variant
SINF_ValiderFormule = False
a_Resultat = SINF_CheckFormulaValid(p_Formule) If a_Resultat(0) = NO_ERROR Then SINF_ValiderFormule = True Else p_Erreur = SINF_GetAPIError(a_Resultat(0)) & " (POS=" & CStr(a_Resultat(1)) & ",LEN=" & CStr(a_Resultat(2)) & ")" End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINF, gc_Element_SINF, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINF_GetAPIError(p_ErrorCode As Integer) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur ' ================================================================================ ' GetAPIError - This function uses the Lotus C API To Return a Notes error's Text message. ' ' Return Value: String - The text associated With the Notes API Error code. ' ================================================================================
Dim iRetVal As Integer Dim sError As String * 1024
SINF_GetAPIError = "Undefined formula error"
sError = String(1024, 0) iRetVal = OSLoadString(0&, p_ErrorCode, sError, 1023) If iRetval <> 0 Then SINF_GetAPIError = Left$(sError, iRetVal) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINF, gc_Element_SINF, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINF_Evaluate(p_Formule As String, pnd As NotesDocument) As Variant On Error GoTo GererErreur ' ================================================================================ ' SINF_Evaluate - This function checks to see if the formula is valid before executing it. ' ' Return Value: An array if the formula was executed without error ' or A string containing the error message if the formula was found to be invalid ' or False if an execution error occured. ' ================================================================================ Dim v_Erreur As String
SINF_Evaluate = False
If SINF_ValiderFormule(p_Formule, v_Erreur) Then If pnd Is nothing then SINF_Evaluate = Evaluate(p_Formule) else SINF_Evaluate = Evaluate(p_Formule, pnd) End if Else SINF_Evaluate = v_Erreur End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINF, gc_Element_SINF, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINF_CheckFormulaValid(p_Formula As String) As Variant On Error GoTo GererErreur ' ================================================================================ ' CheckFormulaValid - This Function uses the Lotus C API To check the syntax of a Notes formula. ' ' Return Value: Variant - A 3 elements array containing: ' Index 0 - The compilation error code Or NO_ERROR (0) If valid ' Index 1 - The compilation error offset In formula Or NO_ERROR If valid ' Index 2 - The compilation error length Or NO_ERROR If valid ' ' Note: The compilation error code at Index 0 can Then be passed To GetAPIError() To Get more info about the error. ' ================================================================================
Dim iError As Integer Dim hFormula As Long Dim wFormulaLen As Integer Dim iCompileError As Integer Dim iCompileErrorLine As Integer Dim iCompileErrorColumn As Integer Dim iCompileErrorOffset As Integer Dim iCompileErrorLength As Integer Dim iArray(2) As Integer
iArray(0) = NO_ERROR iArray(1) = NO_ERROR iArray(2) = NO_ERROR SINF_CheckFormulaValid = iArray
iError = NSFFormulaCompile(0, 0, _ p_Formula, _ Len(p_Formula), _ hFormula, _ wFormulaLen, _ iCompileError, _ iCompileErrorLine, _ iCompileErrorColumn, _ iCompileErrorOffset, _ iCompileErrorLength)
If hFormula <> NULLHANDLE Then Call OSMemFree(hFormula) End If
If iError = ERR_FORMULA_COMPILATION Then iArray(0) = iCompileError iArray(1) = iCompileErrorOffset iArray(2) = iCompileErrorLength SINF_CheckFormulaValid = iArray End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINF, gc_Element_SINF, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Declare ' Use "x_GDK" Use "SI_Extractions"

Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSCS" ou "SDSCS" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSCS" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "CSCo" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSCS As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SDSCS As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSDSCS As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSDSCS As Notesdocument Dim gnv_CSCo_xSDSCS As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_CSCo_xSDSCS As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_CSCo_Client_xSDSCS As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_CSCo_Client_xSDSCS As NotesDocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_CSFa_xSDSCS As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_CSFa_xSDSCS As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_CSPr_xSDSCS As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_CSPr_xSDSCS As NotesDocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSDSCS = "SDSCS" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents ' de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCleCSCo_xSDSCS = "CSCo_NoContratFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCSCo_xSDSCS = "V_CSCo20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleCSCo_Client_xSDSCS = "CSCo_ClientNoFmt" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCSCo_Client_xSDSCS = "V_CSCo12" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleCSFa_xSDSCS = "CSFa_NoContrat" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCSFa_xSDSCS = "V_CSFa20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomVueCSPr_xSDSCS = "V_CSPr30" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Sub Terminate
End Sub

Function xSDSCS_xndTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pCache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_Tabl.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSCS_Initialisations
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd("Tabl_Nom", pCle, pCache, gndb_xSDSCS, "V_Tabl20", gnvTabl_xSDSCS, gndTabl_xSDSCS) ' Paramètres: 1 String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il correspond ' au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSCS_xndTabl = gndTabl_xSDSCS End Function

Function xSDSCS_xVarCSPr_Cle(ByVal p_NoContratFmt As String, ByVal p_CleProduit As String, ByVal p_NomVar As String, ByVal p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.

Le document contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ** Appel de la fonction d'extraction du document ** ' 2 String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le document ' recherché. ** Ne pas modifier ** End Function

' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSCS_Initialisations

Function xSDSCS_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSCS_xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xSDSCS_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xSDSCS_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xSDSCS_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSDSCS_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSDSCS_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSCS_xValeurExisteTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer Dim ni As NotesItem
xSDSCS_xValeurExisteTabl = False
If Not (xSDSCS_xndTabl(p_Cle, True) Is Nothing) Then Set ni = gndTabl_xSDSCS.GetFirstItem("Tabl_Valeurs") If ni.Contains(p_Valeur) Then xSDSCS_xValeurExisteTabl = True End If End If End Function

' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xSDSCS_xndCSCo_Client(p_Cle, p_Cache) xSDSCS_xVarCSCo_Client = xVar(nd, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSCS_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSCS_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSDSCS_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSDSCS_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSCS_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSCS_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSCS_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSCS_xVarCSFa(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
Dim nd As NotesDocument
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) Set nd = xSDSCS_xndCSFa(p_Cle, p_Cache) xSDSCS_xVarCSFa = xVar(nd, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "x_SDSBB" Use "x_SDSCS"

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_SDSCS As NotesSession Dim gndb_SDSCS As NotesDatabase Dim gndb_Base_SDSCS As NotesDatabase
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SDSCS = "SL" Const gc_Element_SDSCS = "SDS_ContratsService"

Sub SDSCS_ClientsModule_Code(p_CodeProduit As String, pa_ClientNoFmt As Variant) ' Retourne la liste des clients qui ont un module dans leur CS ' Paramètres ' p_CodeProduit I Le code du produit à chercher dans les contrats de service ' pa_ClientNoFmt O Un array des numéros des clients qui opnt le module dans leur CS On Error Goto GererErreur
Call SDSCS_ClientsModule(xSDSBB_xVarProd_Code(p_CodeProduit, "Prod_CleProduit", "", True), pa_ClientNoFmt)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCS_PrixModule_Cle(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_CleProduit As String, p_PrixProduit As Double, p_NoContrat As String) As Boolean ' Retourne le prix unitaire d'un service ' Paramètres ' p_ClientNoFmt I Le numéro du client ' p_CleProduit I La clé du produit à chercher dans les contrats de service ' p_PrixProduit O Le prix du produit ' p_NoContrat O Le no du contrat sur lequel le produit se trouve On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nv_Prod As NotesView Dim nd_Prod As NotesDocument Dim v_Prix As Double Dim v_CodeProduit As String
SDSCS_PrixModule_Cle = False p_PrixProduit = 0
' Rechercher le produit dans le CS Set nd = xSDSCS_xndCSCo_Client(p_ClientNoFmt, True)
If Not (nd Is Nothing) Then p_NoContrat = xVar(nd, "CSCO_NoContrat", "") If xVar(nd, "CSCo_TypeInstallation","")="1" Then v_CodeProduit=xSDSBB_xVarProd(p_CleProduit, "Prod_CleProduitAH", "", True) Else v_CodeProduit=xSDSBB_xVarProd(p_CleProduit, "Prod_CleProduitCS", "", True) End If
v_Prix = xSDSCS_xVarCSPr_Cle(xVar(nd, "CSCO_NoContratFmt",""), v_CodeProduit, "CSPr_PrixUnitaire", -1) If v_Prix >= 0 Then p_PrixProduit = v_Prix SDSCS_PrixModule_Cle = True Exit Function End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SDSCS_ClientsModule(p_CleProduit As String, pa_ClientNoFmt As Variant) ' Retourne la liste des clients qui ont un module dans leur CS ' Paramètres ' p_CleProduit I La cle du produit à chercher dans les contrats de service ' pa_ClientNoFmt O Un array des numéros des clients qui opnt le module dans leur CS On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nv_Prod32 As NotesView Dim nd_Prod As NotesDocument Dim nd_Prod_AH As NotesDocument Dim nd_Prod_CS As NotesDocument
Dim v_Formule As String Dim a As Variant
' Validation des paramètres pa_ClientNoFmt = "" If p_CleProduit = "" Then Exit Sub End If
' Initialisations Call xSDSBB_Initialisations
' Liste des codes de produit à vérifier (Sur site + Hébergé) Set nd_Prod = xSDSBB_xndProd(p_CleProduit, True) If nd_Prod Is Nothing Then Exit Sub End If
Set nv_Prod32 = gndb_xSDSBB.getView("V_Prod32") Call nv_Prod32.Refresh Select Case xvar(nd_Prod, "Prod_ClasseProduit", "") Case "AH" : Set nd_Prod_AH = nd_Prod Set nd_Prod = nv_Prod32.GetDocumentByKey(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduit", ""), True) Set nd_Prod_CS = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduitCS", ""), True) Case "CS" : Set nd_Prod_CS = nd_Prod Set nd_Prod = nv_Prod32.GetDocumentByKey(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduit", ""), True) Set nd_Prod_AH = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduitAH", ""), True) Case Else : Set nd_Prod_AH = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduitAH", ""), True) Set nd_Prod_CS = xSDSBB_xndProd(xVar(nd_Prod, "Prod_CleProduitCS", ""), True) End Select
' Liste des clients AH dans les CS If Not (nd_Prod_AH Is Nothing) Then Call xSDSCS_Initialisations v_Formule = |@DbLookup(""; "| & gndb_xSDSCS.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSDSCS.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_CSPr27"; "| & xVar(nd_Prod_AH, "Prod_CleProduit", "") & |"; 3; [FailSilent])| a = Evaluate(v_Formule) If a(0) <> "" Then pa_ClientNoFmt = Evaluate(|@Unique("| & Implode(a, |":"|) & |")|) End If End If
' Liste des clients CS dans les CS If Not (nd_Prod_CS Is Nothing) Then Call xSDSCS_Initialisations v_Formule = |@DbLookup(""; "| & gndb_xSDSCS.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSDSCS.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_CSPr27"; "| & xVar(nd_Prod_CS, "Prod_CleProduit", "") & |"; 3; [FailSilent])| a = Evaluate(v_Formule) If a(0) <> "" Then If Isarray(pa_ClientNoFmt) Then pa_ClientNoFmt = Evaluate(|@Unique("| & Implode(pa_ClientNoFmt, |":"|) & |":"| & Implode(a, |":"|) & |")|) Else pa_ClientNoFmt = Evaluate(|@Unique("| & Implode(a, |":"|) & |")|) End If End If End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SDSCS_PrixModule_Code(p_ClientNoFmt As String, p_CodeProduit As String, p_PrixProduit As Double, p_NoContrat As String) As Boolean ' Retourne le prix unitaire d'un service ' Paramètres ' p_ClientNoFmt I Le numéro du client ' p_CodeProduit I Le code du produit à chercher dans les contrats de service ' p_PrixProduit O Le prix du produit ' p_NoContrat O Le no du contrat sur lequel le produit se trouve On Error Goto GererErreur
SDSCS_PrixModule_Code = SDSCS_PrixModule_Cle(p_ClientNoFmt, xSDSBB_xVarProd_Code(p_CodeProduit, "Prod_CleProduit", "", True), p_PrixProduit, p_NoContrat)
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SDSCS_ExtraireContratService(p_ClientNoFmt As String, pl_ValeursContrat List As Variant) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Statut As String Dim v_NoContratFmt As string Dim a_ClesModules As Variant Dim a_CodesModules As Variant Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_Formule As String Dim v_TypeInstallation As String Dim v_Pos0 As Variant Dim v_Pos1 As Variant
SDSCS_ExtraireContratService = False
' -A- Initialisation de la liste des données du contrat pl_ValeursContrat("NoContrats") = "" ' Numéros de contrats, séparés par ; pl_ValeursContrat("Statut") = "" ' 30=Prêt, 50=En vigueur pl_ValeursContrat("Suspendu") = "" ' 1=oui, ""=non pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "" ' 0=SDSBase, 1=SDSWIN, ""=aucun pl_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDS") = "" ' 1=hébergé, 0=sur site pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "" ' 1=hébergé, 0=sur site pl_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") = "" ' 0=Light, 1=Full, ""=aucun pl_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDSMerlin") = "" ' 1=hébergé, 0=sur site pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDSMerlin") = "" ' 1=hébergé, 0=sur site pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules") = "" ' Liste des clés des modules (array) pl_ValeursContrat("Modules") = "" ' Liste des codes des modules (array) pl_ValeursContrat("ClientFactNoFmt") = "" pl_ValeursContrat("Devise") = "" ' CAD ou USD pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinSDS") = "" pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinSDSMerlin") = "" pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinContratAH") = "" pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinContratSS") = ""
' Extraire le contrat de service Set ndc = xSDSCS_xndcCSCo_Client(p_ClientNoFmt) If ndc.Count = 0 Then Exit Function End If
Set nd = ndc.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing v_Statut = xVar(nd, "CSCo_StatutContrat", "00") If v_Statut > pl_ValeursContrat("Statut") Then pl_ValeursContrat("Statut") = v_Statut End If
If v_Statut >= "50" Then v_NoContratFmt = xVar(nd, "CSCo_NoContratFmt", "") If pl_ValeursContrat("NoContrats") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("NoContrats") = v_NoContratFmt Else pl_ValeursContrat("NoContrats") = pl_ValeursContrat("NoContrats") & ";" & v_NoContratFmt End If
' Liste des modules du CS v_Formule = |@UpperCase(@DbLookup(""; "| & gndb_xSDSCS.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSDSCS.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_CSPr30"; "| & v_NoContratFmt & |"; 2; [FailSilent]))| a_ClesModules = Evaluate(v_Formule) If a_ClesModules(0) <> "" Then v_Formule = |@UpperCase(@DbLookup(""; "| & gndb_xSDSCS.Server & |" : "| & Replace(gndb_xSDSCS.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_CSPr30"; "| & v_NoContratFmt & |"; 3; [FailSilent]))| a_CodesModules = Evaluate(v_Formule)
' Cumuler les modules des CS If Isarray(pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules")) Then pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules") = Arrayunique(Arrayappend(pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules"), a_ClesModules), 1) pl_ValeursContrat("Modules") = Arrayunique(Arrayappend(pl_ValeursContrat("Modules"), a_CodesModules), 1) Else pl_ValeursContrat("ClesModules") = a_ClesModules pl_ValeursContrat("Modules") = a_CodesModules End If
v_TypeInstallation = xVar(nd,"CSCo_TypeInstallation","")
' Verifier les modules pour SDSWin If pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "" then pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "0" End if If v_TypeInstallation = "1" Then v_Pos1 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008697") ' C-SDSWIN v_Pos0 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008661") ' C-SDSBASE
If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008816")) Then ' C-SDSMSERV pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDS") = "1" End If Else v_Pos1 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "9KLNLT") ' S-SDSWIN v_Pos0 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0006122") ' S-SDSBASE End If
If (Not Isnull(v_Pos1)) Or (Not Isnull(v_Pos0)) Then If Not Isnull(v_Pos1) Then pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "1" Elseif Not Isnull(v_Pos0) Then pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "0" End If
pl_ValeursContrat("ClientFactNoFmt") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt", "") pl_ValeursContrat("Devise") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_Devise", "CAD") pl_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDS") = v_TypeInstallation pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinSDS") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_DateFin", "") If v_TypeInstallation = "1" Then pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinContratAH") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_DateFin", "") Else pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinContratSS") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_DateFin", "") End If Else If v_TypeInstallation = "1" Then If pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinContratAH") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinContratAH") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_DateFin", "") End If Else If pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinContratAH") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinContratSS") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_DateFin", "") End If End If End If
' Verifier les modules pour SDS Merlin pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDSMerlin") = "0" If v_TypeInstallation = "1" Then v_Pos1 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008663") ' C-SDSF&IFULL v_Pos0 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008665") ' C-SDSF&ILITE
If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "0008817")) Then 'C-SLSMSERV pl_ValeursContrat("TypeServeurSDSMerlin") = "1" End If Else v_Pos1 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "9KLNPW") ' S-SDSF&IFULL v_Pos0 = Arraygetindex(a_ClesModules, "9KLNPY") ' S-SDSF&ILITE End If
If (Not Isnull(v_Pos1)) Or (Not Isnull(v_Pos0)) Then If Not Isnull(v_Pos1) Then pl_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") = "1" Elseif Not Isnull(v_Pos0) Then pl_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") = "0" End If
If pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("ClientFactNoFmt") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt", "") pl_ValeursContrat("Devise") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_Devise", "CAD") End If pl_ValeursContrat("TypeContratSDSMerlin") = v_TypeInstallation pl_ValeursContrat("DateFinSDSMerlin") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_DateFin", "CAD") End If End If
If pl_ValeursContrat("SDSWin") = "" And pl_ValeursContrat("SDSMerlin") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("ClientFactNoFmt") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_ClientFactNoFmt", "") pl_ValeursContrat("Devise") = xvar(nd, "CSCo_Devise", "CAD") End If
' Vérifier si le contrat est suspendu If xVar(nd, "CSCo_SoutienActif", "") = "" Then pl_ValeursContrat("Suspendu") = "1" End If End If
Set nd = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd) Loop
SDSCS_ExtraireContratService = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SDSCS, gc_Element_SDSCS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSBB" ou "SDSBB" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSBB" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Prod" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSBB As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SDSBB As NotesDocument Dim gnvTabl_xSDSBB As Notesview Dim gndTabl_xSDSBB As Notesdocument Dim gnv_Cate_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Cate_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_TpPp_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_TpPp_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Prod_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Prod_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_ProdCode_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_ProdCode_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées 'Dim gnv_Comp_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document 'Dim gnd_Comp_xSDSBB As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Comp20_xSDSBB As NotesView Dim gnv_Depe20_xSDSBB As NotesView Dim gnd_Comm_xSDSBB As NotesDocument Dim gnv_Comm_xSDSBB As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnv_Prix_xSDSBB As NotesView ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Prix_xSDSBB As NotesDocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSDSBB = "SDSBB" ' Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents ' de recherche, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomItemCate_xSDSBB = "Cate_CleCategorie" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueCate_xSDSBB = "V_Cate20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemTpPp_xSDSBB = "TpPp_CleTypeProposition" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueTpPp_xSDSBB = "V_TpPp20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemProd_xSDSBB = "Prod_CleProduit" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueProd_xSDSBB = "V_Prod20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemProdCode_xSDSBB = "Prod_CodeProduit" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueProdCode_xSDSBB = "V_Prod21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche 'Const gc_NomItemCom_xSDSBB = "Prod_CleComposant" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) 'Const gc_NomVueComp_xSDSBB = "V_Comp20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomVueComm_xSDSBB = "V_Comm20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleComm_xSDSBB = "Comm_CodeCommissions" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomItemPrix_xSDSBB = "Prix_CleProduit" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVuePrix_xSDSBB = "V_Prix21"

Function xSDSBB_xndTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pCache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_Tabl.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSBB_Initialisations
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd("Tabl_Nom", pCle, pCache, gndb_xSDSBB, "V_Tabl20", gnvTabl_xSDSBB, gndTabl_xSDSBB) ' Paramètres: 1 String. Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il correspond ' au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le document est relu même s'il est ' déjà en mémoire. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 4 Notesdatabase. La base de documents dans laquelle le document sera recherché. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' 5 String. Le nom de la vue de recherche. ' 6 Notesview. La vue de recherche. ** Déclarée dans les variables globales ** ' ' 7 Notesdocument. Le document recherché. S'il est déjà en mémoire et que Cache ' contient True, le document envoyé sera retourné. ' ** Déclarée dans les variables globales **
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSBB_xndTabl = gndTabl_xSDSBB End Function

Function xSDSBB_xVarTabl(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pNomVar As String, Byval pValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval pCache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document de type F_Tabl.

Le document contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ** Appel de la fonction d'extraction du document ** ' 2 String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Variant. Function xSDSBB_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSBB_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSBB_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.

Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xSDSBB_xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xTypMLProd(Byval p_Cle As Variant,Byval p_VersionSDS As String) As String '--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 'Cette fonction permet d'extraire le type de média à utiliser pour le programme en question. 'Parametres: p_Cle ---> Nom du programme (logiciel) de SDS Base (LPDBMM) ' p_VersionSDS ----> La version SDS utilisée chez le client (Provient de CSA) 'Retourne le type de média qui correspond à la version SDS pour cette distribution 'pour ce programme '-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dim nd_Logiciel As NotesDocument Dim a_LProdVersion As Variant Dim a_LProdTypeMedia As Variant Dim i As Integer
'Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSBB_Initialisations xSDSBB_xTypMLProd = "Internet"
'Extraire la liste des versions et les médias qui y correspondent Set nd_Logiciel = xSDSBB_xndProd_Code(p_Cle, True) a_LProdVersion = xVarArray(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_MediaVersions") a_LProdTypeMedia = xVarArray(nd_Logiciel, "Prod_MediaTypes")
If Isarray(a_LProdVersion) And Isarray(a_LProdTypeMedia) Then If Ubound(a_LProdVersion) <> Ubound(a_LProdTypeMedia) Then Exit Function End If
'Boucler jusqu'à ce qu'on ait trouvé l'emplacement de la version de SDS de notre client For i = Ubound(a_LProdVersion) To 0 Step -1 If p_VersionSDS >= a_LProdVersion(i) Then 'Retourner le type de média qui correspond à la version SDS xSDSBB_xTypMLProd = a_LProdTypeMedia(i) Exit Function End If Next End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xComplTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_NoComplement As String, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xSDSBB_xComplTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xSDSBB_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Complement" & p_NoComplement, "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xSDSBB_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xSDSBB_xComplTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xSDSBB_xndPrix(Byval p_CleProduit As Variant, Byval p_Devise As String, Byval p_Pays As String, _ Byval p_Province As String, Byval p_NbUsagers As Long) As NotesDocument Dim v_Cle(3) As String Dim nd_Prix As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSBB_Initialisations
' Rechercher le document de prix correspondant aux paramètres v_Cle(0) = p_CleProduit v_Cle(1) = p_Devise v_Cle(2) = p_Pays v_Cle(3) = p_Province Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, gc_NomVuePrix_xSDSBB, gnv_Prix_xSDSBB, nd_Prix)
'2eme lookup ici Do If nd_Prix Is Nothing Then If v_Cle(3) <> "" Then v_Cle(3) = "" Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, gc_NomVuePrix_xSDSBB, gnv_Prix_xSDSBB, nd_Prix) End If If nd_Prix Is Nothing Then If v_Cle(2) <> "" Then v_Cle(2) = "" Call xnd("", v_Cle, False, gndb_xSDSBB, gc_NomVuePrix_xSDSBB, gnv_Prix_xSDSBB, nd_Prix) End If End If End If
' Rechercher le prix en fonction du nombre d'usagers Do Until p_NbUsagers <= xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Usagers", 99999) Set nd_Prix = gnv_Prix_xSDSBB.Getnextdocument(nd_Prix) Set ni = nd_Prix.GetFirstItem("Prix_Province") If xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_CleProduit", "") <> v_Cle(0) _ Or xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Devise", "") <> v_Cle(1) _ Or xVar(nd_Prix, "Prix_Pays", "") <> v_Cle(2) _ Or Not ni.contains(v_Cle(3)) Then Set nd_Prix = Nothing End If Loop Loop While nd_Prix Is Nothing And (v_Cle(2) <> "" Or v_Cle(3) <> "")
Set xSDSBB_xndPrix = nd_Prix End Function

Function xSDSBB_xVarPrix(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_Devise As String, _ Byval p_Pays As String, Byval p_Province As String, Byval p_NbUsagers As Long) As Double ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSBB_xVarPrix = xVar(xSDSBB_xndPrix(p_Cle, p_Devise, p_Pays, p_Province, p_NbUsagers), p_NomVar, 0) End Function

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LEFT" ' // Left Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LEFT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LEFT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LINEFEED", "LF" ' // Linefeed = ^J intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NEWLINE", "NL" ' // New line = Carriage return & Line Feed = ^M^J For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMLOCK" ' // Numeric Lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMLOCK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMLOCK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGDN", "PAGEDOWN", "NEXT" ' // Page Down intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NEXT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NEXT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGUP", "PAGEUP", "PRIOR" ' // Page Up intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRIOR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRIOR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PRINTSCREEN", "PRTSC" ' // Print Screen intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRINT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRINT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "RIGHT" ' // Right Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RIGHT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RIGHT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SCROLLLOCK", "SCRLK" ' // Scroll lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SCROLL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SCROLL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "TAB" ' // Tab = ^I intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_TAB, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_TAB, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "UP" ' // Up Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_UP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_UP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SLEEP" ' // We sleep for a few seconds DoSleep lngNumberOfPushes * 1000 Case "F1" ' // F1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F2" ' // F2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F3" ' // F3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F4" ' // F4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F5" ' // F5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F6" ' // F6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F7" ' // F7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F8" ' // F8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F9" ' // F9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F10" ' // F10 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F10, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F10, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F11" ' // F11 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F11, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F11, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F12" ' // F12 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F12, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F12, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F13" ' // F13 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F13, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F13, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F14" ' // F14 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F14, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F14, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F15" ' // F15 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F15, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F15, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F16" ' // F16 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F16, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F16, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F17" ' // F17 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F17, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F17, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F18" ' // F18 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F18, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F18, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F19" ' // F19 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F19, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F19, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F20" ' // F20 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F20, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F20, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F21" ' // F21 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F21, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F21, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F22" ' // F22 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F22, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F22, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F23" ' // F23 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F23, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F23, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F24" ' // F24 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F24, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F24, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD0" ' // Numeric Keypad 0 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD0, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD0, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD1" ' // Numeric Keypad 1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD2" ' // Numeric Keypad 2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD3" ' // Numeric Keypad 3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD4" ' // Numeric Keypad 4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD5" ' // Numeric Keypad 5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD6" ' // Numeric Keypad 6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD7" ' // Numeric Keypad 7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD8" ' // Numeric Keypad 8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD9" ' // Numeric Keypad 9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADMULTIPLY", "NUMPAD*" ' // Numeric Keypad Multiply intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_MULTIPLY, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_MULTIPLY, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADADD", "NUMPAD+" ' // Numeric Keypad + intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ADD, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ADD, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADSUBTRACT", "NUMPAD-" ' // Numeric Keypad - intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SUBTRACT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SUBTRACT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDECIMAL", "NUMPAD." ' // Numeric Keypad . intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DECIMAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DECIMAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDIVIDE", "NUMPAD/" ' // Numeric Keypad / intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DIVIDE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DIVIDE, intScanKey Next lngCtr
Case "~", "!", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "+","|", "{", "}",_ """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushShiftKey strOriginalCode Next lngCtr
Case Else ' // Ordinary keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushKeys strOriginalCode Next lngCtr End Select Exit Sub
lblPushFNKey_Errs: ' // Should only occur when the number of pushes isn't an integer lngNumberOfPushes = 1 Resume Next End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub
