Sub SIClPP_Initialisations ' Initalisation SDS Propositions II Call xSDSPP_Initialisations
' La base de documents des propositions doit exister If gndb_xSDSPP Is Nothing Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", gc_NomBD_xSDSPP), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End Elseif Not gndb_xSDSPP.IsOpen Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", gc_NomBD_xSDSPP), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End End If End Sub

Sub SIClPP_NouvelleProposition(pnd As NotesDocument) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nd_PNav As NotesDocument Dim nd_SIRR As NotesDocument Dim nd_Vendeur As NotesDocument Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim nd_GClie As NotesDocument Dim nd_SICf As NotesDocument
Dim nd_Cont As NotesDocument Dim nv_Cont_decideur As NotesView 'décideurs du client, utilisée par pour SI Clients seulement Dim nv_Cont_signataire As NotesView 'signataires du client, utilisée par pour SI Clients seulement Dim ndc_decideur As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ndc_signataire As NotesDocumentCollection
Dim a As Variant Dim a_Parametres(1) As String Dim v_Erreur As Boolean Dim v_Pays As String Dim v_Province As String Dim v_NoVendeur As Variant Dim v_SICf_SDSOS As Variant
Dim v_Origine As String Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String
If SLSf_VersionNotesValide = False Then ' 272 - Votre client Notes est trop vieux pour effectuer cette action. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 272, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") If v_ClientNoFmt = "" Then ' 202 - Il n'est pas permis de créer une proposition sans un numéro de client valide ou un projet. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 202, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' Seuls les utilisateurs ayant le rôle SDSP peuvent créer des propositions a = Evaluate(|@IsNotMember("[Admin]" : "[SDSP]"; @UserRoles)|) If a(0) = 1 Then ' 1 - Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à créer de nouvelles propositions. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 1, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' L'adresss du client doit être complète pour créer une proposition v_Erreur = False If xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientPays", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Pays" ElseIf xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientProvince", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Province" ElseIf xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientAdresse1", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Adresse" ElseIf xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientVille", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Ville" ElseIf xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientCodePostal", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Code postal" End If
If v_Erreur Then a_Parametres(0) = v_ClientNoFmt ' 31 - Impossible d'ajouter le client &0 car l'information suivante à propos du client est manquante: &1 MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 31, "", a_Parametres), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' Créer le document de navigation v_Pays = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientPays", "") v_Province = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientProvince", "")
' Le 1er Chargé de compte (de Projeto SDS) deviendra le Rep. des ventes (dans SDS Pro II) Set nd_Vendeur = xPJ_xndClieSI("PJSDS", v_ClientNoFmt, False) v_NoVendeur = xVar(nd_Vendeur, "Clie_NoChargeCompte", "") If IsArray(v_NoVendeur) Then v_NoVendeur = v_NoVendeur(0) End If
If SIClPP_initProposition("SICl", xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientPays", ""), _ xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientProvince", ""), nd_PNav) Then ' Initialiser les champs de la proposition - Client nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNoFmt = v_ClientNoFmt nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNom1 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNom1", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNom2 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNom2", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNomInterne = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNoSF = xVar(pnd, "Clie_NoAccountSF", "")
nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNomLegal = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNomLegal", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNom = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNomEntreprise", "")
nd_PNav.Prop_Langue = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientLangue", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientAdresse1 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientAdresse1", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientAdresse2 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientAdresse2", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientVille = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientVille", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientProvince = v_Province nd_PNav.Prop_ClientPays = v_Pays nd_PNav.Prop_ClientCodePostal = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientCodePostal", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientTelephone = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientTelephone1", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientTelephone2 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientTelephone2", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientTelecopieur = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientTelecopieur", "")
Set nd_GClie = xSICl_xndGCli(xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNo1", 0), True) nd_PNav.Prop_NomGroupeClient = xVar(nd_GClie, "GCli_NomGroupe", "")
' Prop_VersionSDS Set nd_SICf = xSICf_xndSDS(xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", ""), True) nd_PNav.Prop_VersionSDS = xVar(nd_SICf, "SDS_VersionSDS", "")
' Prop_VersionOS v_SICf_SDSOS = Evaluate(| Plateforme := @IfError(@DbLookup( "" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_Serv20"; SDS_NoConfigurationServeur; 6); ""); VersionOS := @IfError(@DbLookup( "" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_Serv20"; SDS_NoConfigurationServeur; 4); ""); VersionsIBMi := @IfError(@DbLookup( "" ; @Subset(@DbName; 1) : "SI_GDK.nsf"; "V_Tabl20"; "Serv_OS_" + Plateforme; 4); ""); Descriptions := @IfError(@DbLookup( "" ; @Subset(@DbName; 1) : "SI_GDK.nsf"; "V_Tabl20"; "Serv_OS_" + Plateforme; 5); ""); @If(@IsNull(Descriptions); VersionOS; @Replace(VersionOS; VersionsIBMi; Descriptions))|, nd_SICf) nd_PNav.Prop_VersionOS = v_SICf_SDSOS(0)
'-----Verifier si le client a seul décideur, si oui Initialiser les champs de la proposition- Info Contact/decideur
Select Case xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientCategorie", "") Case "60" v_Origine = "PJSDS" Case "62" v_Origine = "PJUSA" Case Else v_Origine = "PJDIV" End Select
Call xPJ_Initialisations(v_Origine)
If nv_Cont_signataire Is Nothing Then Set nv_Cont_signataire = gndb_xPJ.Getview("V_Cont25") 'utilisée seulement par SI Client pour le lookup des contacts (signataires) End If
Call nv_Cont_signataire.Refresh
Set ndc_signataire = nv_Cont_signataire.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_ClientNoFmt, True)
If ndc_signataire.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Cont = ndc_signataire.Getfirstdocument
Else
If nv_Cont_decideur Is Nothing Then Set nv_Cont_decideur = gndb_xPJ.Getview("V_Cont23") 'utilisée seulement par SI Client pour le lookup des contacts (decideurs) End If
Call nv_Cont_decideur.Refresh
Set ndc_decideur = nv_Cont_decideur.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_ClientNoFmt, True) If ndc_decideur.Count = 1 Then Set nd_Cont = ndc_decideur.Getfirstdocument End If End If
If Not nd_Cont Is Nothing Then
'Maj des champs Signataire/Contact nd_PNav.Prop_NoContact = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_NoContact", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactNom = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Contact", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactFonction = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Fonction", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactFonctionFR = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_FonctionFR", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactFonctionEN = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_FonctionEN", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactTitre = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Titre", "")
If xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_TelephoneFmt", "") <> "" Then nd_PNav.Prop_ContactTelephone = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_TelephoneFmt", "") End If
If xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Cellulaire", "") <> "" Then nd_PNav.Prop_ContactCellulaire = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Cellulaire", "") End If
nd_PNav.Prop_ContactCourriel = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Courriel", "")
End If
'------------------------------------------------
If v_Pays = "" Then v_Pays = "CA" End If nd_PNav.Prop_Devise = xGDK_xCompTabl(v_Pays, "ISO3166-1xFR", "1", False) nd_PNav.Site_Banniere = xVar(pnd, "SDS_Bannieres", "") nd_PNav.Site_BanniereDesc = xVar(pnd, "SDS_BannieresDesc", "") nd_PNav.Prop_Origine = "SICl"
' Ouvrir le document de navigation Call nuiws.EditDocument(True, nd_PNav) End If Exit Sub

' Seuls les utilisateurs ayant le rôle SDSP peuvent créer des propositions a = Evaluate(|@IsNotMember("[Admin]" : "[SDSP]"; @UserRoles)|) If a(0) = 1 Then ' 1 - Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à créer de nouvelles propositions. MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 1, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' L'adresss du client doit être complète pour créer une proposition v_Erreur = False If xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientPays", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Pays" ElseIf xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientProvince", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Province" ElseIf xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientAdresse1", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Adresse" ElseIf xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientVille", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Ville" ElseIf xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientCodePostal", "") = "" Then v_Erreur = True a_Parametres(1) = "Code postal" End If
If v_Erreur Then a_Parametres(0) = v_ClientNoFmt ' 31 - Impossible d'ajouter le client &0 car l'information suivante à propos du client est manquante: &1 MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SDSPP", 31, "", a_Parametres), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
' Créer le document de navigation v_Pays = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientPays", "") v_Province = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientProvince", "")
' Le 1er Chargé de compte (de Projeto SDS) deviendra le Rep. des ventes (dans SDS Pro II) Set nd_Vendeur = xPJ_xndClieSI("PJSDS", v_ClientNoFmt, False) v_NoVendeur = xVar(nd_Vendeur, "Clie_NoChargeCompte", "") If IsArray(v_NoVendeur) Then v_NoVendeur = v_NoVendeur(0) End If
If SIClP3_initProposition("SICl", xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientPays", ""), _ xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientProvince", ""), nd_PNav) Then ' Initialiser les champs de la proposition - Client nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNoFmt = v_ClientNoFmt nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNom1 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNom1", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNom2 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNom2", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNomInterne = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNomInterne", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNoSF = xVar(pnd, "Clie_NoAccountSF", "")
nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNomLegal = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNomLegal", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientNom = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNomEntreprise", "")
nd_PNav.Prop_Langue = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientLangue", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientAdresse1 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientAdresse1", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientAdresse2 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientAdresse2", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientVille = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientVille", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientProvince = v_Province nd_PNav.Prop_ClientPays = v_Pays nd_PNav.Prop_ClientCodePostal = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientCodePostal", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientTelephone = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientTelephone1", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientTelephone2 = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientTelephone2", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ClientTelecopieur = xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientTelecopieur", "")
nd_PNav.Prop_TypeContratServiceSDS = xVar(pnd, "Clie_TypeContratServiceSDS", "")
Set nd_GClie = xSICl_xndGCli(xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNo1", 0), True) nd_PNav.Prop_NomGroupeClient = xVar(nd_GClie, "GCli_NomGroupe", "")
' Prop_VersionSDS Set nd_SICf = xSICf_xndSDS(xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", ""), True) nd_PNav.Prop_VersionSDS = xVar(nd_SICf, "SDS_VersionSDS", "")
' Prop_VersionOS v_SICf_SDSOS = Evaluate(| Plateforme := @IfError(@DbLookup( "" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_Serv20"; SDS_NoConfigurationServeur; 6); ""); VersionOS := @IfError(@DbLookup( "" : "NoCache"; ""; "V_Serv20"; SDS_NoConfigurationServeur; 4); ""); VersionsIBMi := @IfError(@DbLookup( "" ; @Subset(@DbName; 1) : "SI_GDK.nsf"; "V_Tabl20"; "Serv_OS_" + Plateforme; 4); ""); Descriptions := @IfError(@DbLookup( "" ; @Subset(@DbName; 1) : "SI_GDK.nsf"; "V_Tabl20"; "Serv_OS_" + Plateforme; 5); ""); @If(@IsNull(Descriptions); VersionOS; @Replace(VersionOS; VersionsIBMi; Descriptions))|, nd_SICf) nd_PNav.Prop_VersionOS = v_SICf_SDSOS(0)
'-----Verifier si le client a un seul décideur, si oui Initialiser les champs de la proposition- Info Contact/decideur
Select Case xVar(pnd, "Clie_ClientCategorie", "") Case "60" v_Origine = "PJSDS" Case "62" v_Origine = "PJUSA" Case Else v_Origine = "PJDIV" End Select
Call xPJ_Initialisations(v_Origine)
If nv_Cont_signataire Is Nothing Then Set nv_Cont_signataire = gndb_xPJ.Getview("V_Cont25") 'utilisée seulement par SI Client pour le lookup des contacts (signataires) End If
Call nv_Cont_signataire.Refresh
Set ndc_signataire = nv_Cont_signataire.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_ClientNoFmt, True)
If ndc_signataire.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Cont = ndc_signataire.Getfirstdocument
Else
If nv_Cont_decideur Is Nothing Then Set nv_Cont_decideur = gndb_xPJ.Getview("V_Cont23") 'utilisée seulement par SI Client pour le lookup des contacts (decideurs) End If
Call nv_Cont_decideur.Refresh
Set ndc_decideur = nv_Cont_decideur.GetAllDocumentsByKey(v_ClientNoFmt, True) If ndc_decideur.Count = 1 Then Set nd_Cont = ndc_decideur.Getfirstdocument End if End if
If Not nd_Cont Is Nothing Then
'Maj des champs Signataire/Contact nd_PNav.Prop_NoContact = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_NoContact", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactNom = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Contact", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactFonction = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Fonction", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactFonctionFR = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_FonctionFR", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactFonctionEN = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_FonctionEN", "") nd_PNav.Prop_ContactTitre = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Titre", "")
If xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_TelephoneFmt", "") <> "" Then nd_PNav.Prop_ContactTelephone = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_TelephoneFmt", "") End If
If xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Cellulaire", "") <> "" Then nd_PNav.Prop_ContactCellulaire = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Cellulaire", "") End If
nd_PNav.Prop_ContactCourriel = xVar(nd_Cont, "Cont_Courriel", "")
End If
'------------------------------------------------
If v_Pays = "" Then v_Pays = "CA" End If
nd_PNav.Prop_Devise = xGDK_xCompTabl(v_Pays, "ISO3166-1xFR", "1", False) nd_PNav.Site_Banniere = xVar(pnd, "SDS_Bannieres", "") nd_PNav.Site_BanniereDesc = xVar(pnd, "SDS_BannieresDesc", "") nd_PNav.Prop_Origine = "SICl"
' Ouvrir le document de navigation Call nuiws.EditDocument(True, nd_PNav) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIClP3, gc_Element_SIClP3, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SIClP3_initProposition(p_Origine As String, p_Pays As String, _ p_Province As String,pnd_PNav As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd_PNav As NotesDocument
' Initialisations SIClP3_initProposition = False Set gns_SDSP3 = New NotesSession Call SIClP3_Initialisations
' Créer le document de navigation Set nd_PNav = New NotesDocument(gndb_xSDSP3) nd_PNav.Form = "F_PNav0.00" nd_PNav.Prop_Origine = p_Origine
' Initialiser le type de proposition nd_PNav.Prop_TypeProposition = "2"
nd_PNav.HistoUC = gns_SDSP3.UserName nd_PNav.PNav_EditMode = 1
Set pnd_PNav = nd_PNav SIClP3_initProposition = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIClP3, gc_Element_SIClP3, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SIClP3_Initialisations ' Initalisation SDS Propositions II Call xSDSP3_Initialisations
' La base de documents des propositions doit exister If gndb_xSDSP3 Is Nothing Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", gc_NomBD_xSDSP3), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End Elseif Not gndb_xSDSP3.IsOpen Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", gc_NomBD_xSDSP3), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") End End If End Sub

Option Public Option Declare Use "x_GDK" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire ne se trouvent pas dans la base de documents courante. Il faut rechercher la base de documents ' à utiliser dans le GDK. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être "x_SDSP" ou "SDSP" est ' l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' 2. Inscrire le nom usuel de la base de documents de recherche, le nom de l'item qui contient ' la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "SDSP" par l'identifiant de la base de documents. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés. ' 4. Remplacer toutes les occurences de "Prop" par l'identifiant du type de document. ' Les subs seront automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xELrod Dim gndb_xSDSP3 As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnd_Prof_SDSP3 As NotesDocument Dim gnv_Prop_xSDSP3 As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Prop_xSDSP3 As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Site_xSDSP3 As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_Site_xSDSP3 As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées Dim gnv_Site21_xSDSP3 As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnv_MOpt_xSDSP3 As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_MOpt_xSDSP3 As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomBD_xSDSP3 = "SDSP3" ' Inscrire le nom de la base de documents, tel que déclaré dans le GDK. Const gc_NomVueProp_xSDSP3 = "V_Prop20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleProp_xSDSP3 = "Prop_NoProposition" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueSite_xSDSP3 = "V_Site20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche Const gc_NomItemCleSite_xSDSP3 = "Site_NoSite" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVueSite21_xSDSP3 = "V_Site21" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche
Sub xSDSP3_Initialisations ' Initialisation des variables globales If gndb_xSDSP3 Is Nothing Then Set gndb_xSDSP3 = xGDK_xndbNDB(gc_NomBD_xSDSP3) End If End Sub

Function xSDSP3_xndProp(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSP3_Initialisations
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleProp_xSDSP3, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSDSP3, gc_NomVueProp_xSDSP3, gnv_Prop_xSDSP3, gnd_Prop_xSDSP3)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSP3_xndProp = gnd_Prop_xSDSP3 End Function

Function xSDSP3_xVarProp(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSP3_xVarProp = xVar(xSDSP3_xndProp(p_Cle, p_Cache), p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSP3_xndcSite(Byval p_Cle As Variant) As NotesdocumentCollection ' Cette fonction retourne une collection de documents du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSP3_Initialisations Call xnv(gndb_xSDSP3, "V_Site21", gnv_Site21_xSDSP3)
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Set xSDSP3_xndcSite = gnv_Site21_xSDSP3.GetAllDocumentsByKey(p_Cle, True) End Function

Function xSDSP3_xndSite(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type apSiterié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call xSDSP3_Initialisations
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCleSite_xSDSP3, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xSDSP3, gc_NomVueSite_xSDSP3, gnv_Site_xSDSP3, gnd_Site_xSDSP3)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xSDSP3_xndSite = gnd_Site_xSDSP3 End Function

Function xSDSP3_xVarSite(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSP3_xVarSite = xVar(xSDSP3_xndSite(p_Cle, p_Cache), p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Function xSDSP3_xVarProf(Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable du profil.
Call xSDSP3_Initialisations If gnd_Prof_SDSP3 Is Nothing Then Set gnd_Prof_SDSP3 = gndb_xSDSP3.GetProfileDocument("F_Prof") End If
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xSDSP3_xVarProf = xVar(gnd_Prof_SDSP3, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_NotesAPI" Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

Const NSF_INFO_SIZE = 128 Const INFOPARSE_DESIGN = 3 Const NOTE_ID_ICON = &HFFFF0010
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_SINDB = "SL" Const gc_Element_SINDB = "SI_NotesDatabase"

Function SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim dp As String Dim s% Dim rc% Dim hDB As Long Dim dbserver$ Dim dbfilepath$ Dim nri As SINAPI_DBREPLICAINFO
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = False
dbserver$ = pndb.Server dbfilepath$ = pndb.Filepath
dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
s% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dp$, hDB)
If hDB = 0 Then Exit Function
If dbserver$ = "" Then rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dbfilepath$, hDb) Else rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(dbserver$ & "!!" & dbfilepath$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
' Droits Admin requis pour executer, sinon erreur 'Set nr = pndb.ReplicationInfo 'Call nr.ClearHistory() 'Call nr.Save()
' Vider historique de réplication rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDB, nri) rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClearReplHistory( hDB ,0 ) rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDB, nri)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Impossible de vider l'historique de réplication : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClose(hDB)
SINDB_ViderHistoriqueReplication = True
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SINDB_RefreshDesign(templateserver$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$

SINAPI_DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Sub SINDB_SetDesignTemplate(templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) SINAPI_NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_ndGetDesignElement(pndb As NotesDatabase, p_TypeElement As String, p_NomElement As String) As NotesDocument ' PAS TESTÉ ************************************** On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim nnc As NotesNoteCollection Dim s As String Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim ni As NotesItem
Set ndb = ns.CurrentDatabase Set nnc = pndb.CreateNoteCollection(False) Select Case p_TypeElement Case "F": nnc.SelectForms = True Case "V": nnc.SelectViews = True Case Else Call nnc.SelectAllDesignElements(True) End Select ' nnc.SelectionFormula = |@IsMember("F_Tabl"; @GetField("$Title"))| Call nnc.BuildCollection
s = nnc.Getfirstnoteid Do Until s = "" Set nd = ndb.GetDocumentById(s) Set ni = nd.Getfirstitem("$TITLE") If ni.Contains(p_NomElement) Then Set SINDB_ndGetDesignElement = nd Exit Do End If s = nnc.Getnextnoteid(s) Loop Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SINDB_ChangerIDReplique(pndb As NotesDatabase) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim Server As String Dim FileName As String Dim Rep As String Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim hDb As Long Dim rc% Dim RepInfo As SINAPI_DBREPLICAINFO Dim var As Variant
SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = False server$ = pndb.Server filename$ = pndb.FilePath Do Set ndb = New NotesDatabase("", "") rep$ = Right("00000000" & Cstr(Clng(Today)), 8) & Right("00000000" & Cstr(Int((Now - Today) * 100000000)), 8) Loop Until Not ndb.OpenByReplicaID(server$, rep$)
If Server$ = "" Then rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(FileName$, hDb) Else rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbOpen(Server$ & "!!" & FileName$, hDb) End If
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: Base de documents introuvable : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo)
If rc% <> 0 Then Print "E: L'information de la réplique n'est pas disponible : " & pndb.Title Exit Function End If
RepInfo.ID.Innards(1) = Val( "&H"+Left$( rep$, 8 ) ) RepInfo.ID.Innards(0) = Val( "&H"+Right$( rep$, 8 ) )
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoSet(hDb, RepInfo) ' take a deep breath... :-)
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbReplicaInfoGet(hDb, RepInfo) If rc% <> 0 Then Print "*** Impossible de vérifier si le nouvel ID de réplique a été modifié correctement : " & pndb.Title Else Print "Le nouvel ID de réplique de la base de documents « " & pndb.Title & " » est " & Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(1)), 8) + ":" + Right("0000000" + Hex(RepInfo.ID.Innards(0)), 8) End If
rc% = SINAPI_NSFDbClose(hDb) SINDB_ChangerIDReplique = True Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Sub SINDB_ReplaceDesign(templateserver$, templatename$, dbserver$, dbfilepath$) Dim dp As String dp$ = String(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, dbserver$, dbfilepath$, dp$
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen dp$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Sub
Dim d As String d$ = Space(NSF_INFO_SIZE) SINAPI_NSFDbInfoGet hDB, d$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoModify d$, INFOPARSE_DESIGN, templatename$ SINAPI_NSFDbInfoSet hDB, d$
Dim hNT As Long SINAPI_NSFNoteOpen hDB, NOTE_ID_ICON, 0, hNT SINAPI_NSFItemSetText hNT, "$TITLE", d$, Instr(d$, Chr$(0)) SINAPI_NSFNoteUpdate hNT, 0 SINAPI_NSFNoteClose hNT
SINAPI_DesignRefresh templateserver$, hDB, 1, 0, 0
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Sub

Function SINDB_NotesURL(pndb As NotesDatabase) As String ' Retourne l'URL permettant d'ouvrir un document dans Notes. ' Format: Notes://DbReplicaId/ViewNoteUNID/DocUNID On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Serveur As String Dim v_URL As String
If pndb Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
v_Serveur = pndb.Server If v_Serveur = "" Then Exit Function End If
v_URL = "Notes://" & StrRight(StrLeft(v_Serveur, "/"), "=") & "/" & pndb.Replicaid SINDB_NotesURL = v_URL
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SINDB, gc_Element_SINDB, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_GestionConflits"
' Traitement des erreurs ' ------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_A = "A" Const gc_Element_A = "A_SIGC"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Roles As Variant Dim ns As New Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Doit avoir le rôle Admin pour utiliser cette action v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) <> 1 Then Messagebox "Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à utiliser cette action.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set nv = ndb.GetView("V_SIGC")
Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
'***** Insérer les instructions de correction içi ***** If SIGC_ResoudreConflit(nd, 1, "") Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) End If Loop
Print "Fin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "wsc_AdmV"

Dim gns_VAdmS As notesSession Dim gndb_VAdmS As NotesDatabase
Dim gnuiws_VAdmS As notesuiworkspace
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_VAdmS = "SL" Const gc_Element_VAdmS = "V_AdmV"

Sub VAdmS_acDeverrouiller '=============================================================== ' Déverrouiller les documents sélectionnés '=============================================================== On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim ws_AdmV As New cl_AdmV Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim nd_Suivant As NotesDocument Dim i As integer Dim v_NbMaj As long
' Initialisations Call VAdmS_Initialisations
Set ndc = gndb_VAdmS.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then ' Aucun document sélectionné. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 2, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Sub End If
'Valider avec l'usager If Messagebox(xGDK_xMessage("SI", 223, "", ""), 36, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 98, "", Cstr(ndc.Count))) <> 6 Then Exit Sub End If
' Initialiser le web service Set ws_AdmV = New cl_AdmV
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant)
i = ws_AdmV.DeverrouillerDocument(gndb_VAdmS.Server, gndb_VAdmS.FilePath, nd.Universalid) If i >= 0 Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 else MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 224, "", "") & " (" & cstr(i) & ")", 48, "Déverouillage" End If Loop
Call gnuiws_VAdmS.CurrentView.Deselectall Call gnuiws_VAdmS.ViewRefresh Print xGDK_xMessage("SI", 225, "", Cstr(v_NbMaj)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_VAdmS, gc_Element_VAdmS, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub VAdmS_Initialisations If gns_VAdmS Is Nothing Then Set gns_VAdmS = New notesSession Set gndb_VAdmS = gns_VAdmS.CurrentDatabase
Set gnuiws_VAdmS = New notesuiworkspace End If End Sub

Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Selection"

' Déclarations globales ' ---------------------------------- Dim gns_SISt As Notessession Dim gndb_SISt As Notesdatabase Dim gnuiws_SISt As NotesUIWorkspace
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SISt = "SL" Const gc_Element_SISt = "SI_Statistiques"

Sub SISt_Executer(p_NomBaseStat As String, p_Model As String, p_Parametres As String)
On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim p_NoPage As string
If Not SISt_Initialisations( p_NomBaseStat ) Then Exit sub End If
Call SISt_ExecuterSurServeur( p_NomBaseStat, p_Model, p_Parametres, p_NoPage ) Call SISt_OuvrirPageWeb( p_NomBaseStat, p_NoPage )
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISt, gc_Element_SISt, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Function SISt_Initialisations( p_NomBase As string ) As Boolean
SISt_Initialisations = false
If gns_SISt Is Nothing Then Set gns_SISt = New Notessession Set gndb_SISt = xGDK_xndbNDB( p_NomBase ) Set gnuiws_SISt = New NotesUIWorkspace
If gndb_SISt Is Nothing Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", p_NomBase), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function Elseif Not gndb_SISt.IsOpen Then ' 48 - La base de documents & est introuvable. Messagebox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 48, "", p_NomBase), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Exit Function End If
End If SISt_Initialisations = true End Function

Sub SISt_ExecuterSurServeur(p_NomBaseStat As String, p_Model As String, p_Parametre As String, p_NoPage As String) On Error GoTo GererErreur ' Utilise un agent (runonserver) pour générer le rapport
Dim ndb_SITmp As NotesDatabase Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim na As NotesAgent
' Initialisations Call SISt_Initialisations( p_NomBaseStat )
Set ndb_SITmp = xGDK_xndbNDB("SITp") Set nd = New NotesDocument(ndb_SITmp) nd.Form = "F_SISt" nd.Modele = p_Model p_NoPage = xUnique("") nd.NoPage = p_NoPage nd.User = gns_SISt.CommonUserName nd.Parametre = p_Parametre nd.Langue = xLangue Call nd.Save(True, False)
Set na = gndb_SISt.GetAgent("A_GRap") Call na.RunOnServer(nd.NoteId)
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISt, gc_Element_SISt, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub SISt_OuvrirPageWeb( p_NomBaseStat As String, p_NoPage As String)
On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndb_SIWb As NotesDatabase Dim a_NoPage As Variant Dim v_Serveur As Variant Dim v_FilePath As String Dim v_EvaluateDBLkup As string
If Not SISt_Initialisations( p_NomBaseStat ) Then Exit Sub End If
Set ndb_SIWb = xGDK_xndbNDB("SIIn")
v_EvaluateDBLkup = |@DbLookup(""; "| & ndb_SIWb.Server & |" : "| & Replace(ndb_SIWb.FilePath, "\", "\\") & _ |"; "V_PWeb"; "| & p_NoPage & |"; 1; [FailSilent])| a_NoPage = Evaluate( v_EvaluateDBLkup ) If a_NoPage(0) = "" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SI", 127, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Else v_Serveur = Evaluate(|@Lowercase(@Name([CN]; "| & ndb_SIWb.Server & |"))|) v_FilePath = ndb_SIWb.Filepath & "/V_PWeb/" & p_NoPage & "?Opendocument"
If v_Serveur(0) = "cpamtl" Then Call gnuiws_SISt.URLOpen("http://cpamtl.cpamontreal.ca/" & v_FilePath, True) ElseIf v_Serveur(0) = "cpamau" Then Call gnuiws_SISt.URLOpen("http://192.168.1.201/" & v_FilePath, True) Else Call gnuiws_SISt.URLOpen("http://" & v_Serveur(0) & ".serti.com/" & v_FilePath, True) End If End If Exit Sub
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SISt, gc_Element_SISt, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New Notesuiworkspace Dim ndc_Clie As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd_Clie As NotesDocument Dim v_ClientNoFmt As String Dim v_URL As String
Call A_Initialisations
Set ndc_Clie = gndb_Clie.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc_Clie.Count > 0 Then Set nd_Clie = ndc_Clie.GetFirstDocument If xVar(nd_Clie, "SDS_SDSWeb", "") <> "1" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 30, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") else v_ClientNoFmt = xVar(nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") v_URL = SICf_SDSWeb_URL(v_ClientNoFmt) If v_URL = "" Then MessageBox xGDK_xMessage("SICf", 29, "", ""), 16, xGDK_xMessage("SI", 1, "", "") Else Call nuiws.URLOpen(v_URL) End If End If End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_A, gc_Element_A, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub A_Initialisations
If gns_Clie Is Nothing Then Set gns_Clie = New NotesSession Set gndb_Clie = gns_Clie.CurrentDatabase End If
End Sub

' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_wsc = "SL" Const gc_Element_wsc = "wsc_LSCSD"
Public Class PortTypeBase
Private Service As NotesWebServiceEngine Private NoFault As WS_FAULT
Public Sub New() Set Service = New NotesWebServiceEngine Set NoFault = New WS_FAULT End Sub
Public Sub SetEndpoint(url As String) Call Service.SetEndpoint(url) End Sub
Public Function GetEndpoint() As String GetEndpoint = Service.GetEndpoint() End Function
Public Function GetLastFault() As WS_FAULT Set GetLastFault = Service.GetLastFault If (GetLastFault Is Nothing) Then Set GetLastFault = NoFault End If End Function
Public Sub SetTimeout(ms As Long) Call Service.SetTimeout(ms) End Sub
Public Function GetTimeout() As Long GetTimeout = Service.GetTimeout() End Function
Public Sub SetCredentials(username As String, password As String) Call Service.SetCredentials(username, password) End Sub
Public Sub SetSSLOptions(Opt As Long) Call Service.SetSSLOptions(Opt) End Sub
Public Function GetSSLOptions() As Long GetSSLOptions = Service.GetSSLOptions() End Function
End Class

Function wsc_ExtraireDoubleXSD(p_xsdD As XSD_Double, p_ValeurNulle As Double) As Double On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim s As String
If p_xsdD Is Nothing Then wsc_ExtraireDoubleXSD = p_ValeurNulle Else s = p_xsdD.GetValueAsString If s = "" Then wsc_ExtraireDoubleXSD = p_ValeurNulle Else wsc_ExtraireDoubleXSD = CDbl(s) End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_wsc, gc_Element_wsc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function wsc_AssignerDoubleXSD(p_Valeur As Double) As XSD_Double On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_xsdD As New XSD_Double Dim s As string
s = CStr(p_Valeur) Call v_xsdD.Setvaluefromstring(s) Set wsc_AssignerDoubleXSD = v_xsdD Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_wsc, gc_Element_wsc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function wsc_AssignerDateXSD(p_Date As Variant) As XSD_DateTime On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("") Dim v_xsdDT As New XSD_DateTime
If p_Date <> "" then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Date Call ndt.SetAnyTime
Call v_xsdDT.Setvaluefromnotesdatetime(ndt) Set wsc_AssignerDateXSD = v_xsdDT Else Set wsc_AssignerDateXSD = Nothing End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_wsc, gc_Element_wsc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function wsc_ExtraireStringXSD(p_xsdS As XSD_String, p_ValeurNulle As string) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim s As String
If p_xsdS Is Nothing Then wsc_ExtraireStringXSD = p_ValeurNulle Else s = p_xsdS.GetValueAsString If s = "" Then wsc_ExtraireStringXSD = p_ValeurNulle Else wsc_ExtraireStringXSD = s End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_wsc, gc_Element_wsc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function wsc_ExtraireDateXSD(p_xsdDT As XSD_DateTime, p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim s As string Dim ndt As NotesDateTime Dim v_Date As Variant
If p_xsdDT Is Nothing Then wsc_ExtraireDateXSD = p_ValeurNulle Else s = p_xsdDT.GetValueAsString If s = "" Then wsc_ExtraireDateXSD = p_ValeurNulle Else Set ndt = p_xsdDT.GetValueAsNotesDateTime v_Date = ndt.LSGMTTime If v_Date = "" Then wsc_ExtraireDateXSD = p_ValeurNulle Else wsc_ExtraireDateXSD = v_Date End If End If End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_wsc, gc_Element_wsc, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Dim gns_SIW As NotesSession
Type gt_Rectangle x1 As Long y1 As Long x2 As Long y2 As Long End Type
Type gt_Resolution Largeur As Long Longeur As Long End Type
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIW = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIW = "SI_Windows"
Declare Function GetDesktopWindow Lib "User32" () As Long Declare Function GetForegroundWindow Lib "User32" () As Long Declare Function GetWindowRect Lib "User32" (ByVal hWnd As Long, rectangle As gt_Rectangle) As Long

Function SIW_PosteDeTravail As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim a(6) As String Dim objWMIService As Variant Dim colItems As Variant Dim m_oWSHNet As Variant
For i = 0 To 6 a(i) = "n. d." Next
On Error 207 Goto FinSub Set objWMIService = GetObject("winmgmts:{impersonationLevel=impersonate}!\\.\root\cimv2")
Set colItems = objWMIService.ExecQuery("Select * from Win32_ComputerSystem") Forall objItem In colItems On Error Resume Next a(0) = objItem.Domain a(1) = objItem.Manufacturer a(2) = objItem.Model a(3) = objItem.Name a(4) = objItem.NumberOfLogicalProcessors a(5) = objItem.TotalPhysicalMemory a(6) = objItem.UserName On Error Goto GererErreur End Forall
FinSub: SIW_PosteDeTravail = a Exit Function
GererErreur207: On Error 207 Goto FinSub Set m_oWSHNet = CreateObject("WScript.Network") ' Set m_oWSHShell = createobject("WScript.shell")
On Error Goto FinSub a(0) = m_oWshNet.UserDomain a(3) = m_oWshNet.computerName a(6) = m_oWshNet.UserName Goto FinSub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function
Sub SIW_Initialisations If gns_SIW Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIW = New NotesSession End If End Sub

Function SIW_WS_UserName As String On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_WS_Network As Variant
Set v_WS_Network = createobject("WScript.Network") SIW_WS_UserName = v_WS_Network.UserName Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIW_Reseau As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a(2) As String Dim i As Integer Dim objWMIService As Variant Dim colItems As Variant
On Error 207 Goto GererErreur207 Set objWMIService = GetObject("winmgmts:{impersonationLevel=impersonate}!\\.\root\cimv2")
Set colItems = objWMIService.ExecQuery("Select IPAddress, DefaultIPGateway, DNSServerSearchOrder from Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration ") Forall objItem In colItems If Not Isnull(objItem.IPAddress) Then For i = Lbound(objItem.IPAddress) To Ubound(objItem.IPAddress) If objItem.IPAddress(i) <> "" And objItem.IPAddress(i) <> "0.0.0.0" Then If a(0) = "" Then a(0) = objItem.IPAddress(i) Else a(0) = a(0) & ":" & objItem.IPAddress(i) End If End If Next End If
If Not Isnull(objItem.DefaultIPGateway) Then For i = Lbound(objItem.DefaultIPGateway) To Ubound(objItem.DefaultIPGateway) If Cstr(objItem.DefaultIPGateway(i)) <> "" Then If a(1) = "" Then a(1) = Cstr(objItem.DefaultIPGateway(i)) Else a(1) = a(1) & ":" & Cstr(objItem.DefaultIPGateway(i)) End If End If Next End If
If Not Isnull(objItem.DNSServerSearchOrder) Then For i = Lbound(objItem.DNSServerSearchOrder) To Ubound(objItem.DNSServerSearchOrder) If objItem.DNSServerSearchOrder(i) <> "" Then If a(2) = "" Then a(2) = objItem.DNSServerSearchOrder(i) Else a(2) = a(2) & ":" & objItem.DNSServerSearchOrder(i) End If End If Next End If End Forall
FinSub: SIW_Reseau = a Exit Function
GererErreur207: For i = Lbound(a) To Ubound(a) a(i) = "n. d." Next Goto FinSub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIW_ResolutionFenetre(p_Resolution As gt_Resolution) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Rectangle As gt_Rectangle Dim v_hWnd As Long ' Dim RetVal As Long
v_hWnd = GetForegroundWindow () ' RetVal = GetWindowRect(v_hWnd, v_Rectangle) Call GetWindowRect(v_hWnd, v_Rectangle) p_Resolution.Largeur = v_Rectangle.x2 - v_Rectangle.x1 p_Resolution.Longeur = v_Rectangle.y2 - v_Rectangle.y1 SIW_ResolutionFenetre = CStr(p_Resolution.Largeur) & "x" & CStr(p_Resolution.Longeur) Exit Function
GererErreur: SIW_ResolutionFenetre = "ERR" Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIW_SystemeExploitation As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Integer Dim a(5) As String Dim objWMIService As Variant Dim colItems As Variant
On Error 207 Goto GererErreur207 Set objWMIService = GetObject("winmgmts:{impersonationLevel=impersonate}!\\.\root\cimv2")
Set colItems = objWMIService.ExecQuery("Select * from Win32_OperatingSystem",,48) Forall objItem In colItems On Error Resume Next a(0) = objItem.BuildNumber a(1) = objItem.Caption a(2) = objItem.SerialNumber a(3) = objItem.ServicePackMajorVersion a(4) = objItem.ServicePackMinorVersion a(5) = objItem.TotalVisibleMemorySize On Error Goto GererErreur End Forall
FinSub: SIW_SystemeExploitation = a Exit Function
GererErreur207: For i = Lbound(a) To Ubound(a) a(i) = "n. d." Next Goto FinSub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIW_aTachesActives As Variant ' Détermine si un programme est actif sur l'ordinateur ' p_NomProgramme est le nom de l'objet ex.: notepad.exe On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 75 Resume Next
Dim v_CheminScript As String Dim v_CheminFichier As String Dim v_Commande As String Dim v_NoFichier As Integer Dim oShell As Variant Dim s As String Redim a(99) As String Dim l As Long
v_CheminScript = Environ("TEMP") & "\SIW" Mkdir v_CheminScript
v_CheminScript = v_CheminScript & "\" & xUnique("") & ".bat" Kill v_CheminScript
v_CheminFichier = Strleftback(v_CheminScript, ".") & ".log" Kill v_CheminFichier
' Construire le script v_Commande = |tasklist /NH /FO CSV > | & v_CheminFichier v_NoFichier = Freefile() Open v_CheminScript For Append As v_NoFichier Print #v_NoFichier, v_Commande Close v_NoFichier
' Exécuter le script Set oShell = CreateObject("Wscript.Shell") oShell.Run v_CheminScript, 1, True
' Lire le fichier résultat v_NoFichier = Freefile() On Error 101 Goto ErreurOpen Open v_CheminFichier For Input As v_NoFichier Do Until Eof(v_NoFichier) Line Input #v_NoFichier, s a(l) = s If l = Ubound(a) Then Redim Preserve a(l + 100) As String End If l = l + 1 Loop Close v_NoFichier If l > 0 Then Redim Preserve a(l) As String End If SIW_aTachesActives = a
ErreurOpen: ' Supprimer les fichiers temporaires Kill v_CheminScript Kill v_CheminFichier Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIW_TacheActive(p_NomProgramme As String) As Boolean ' Détermine su un programme est actif sur l'ordinateur ' p_NomProgramme est le nom de l'objet ex.: notepad.exe On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 75 Resume Next
Dim v_CheminScript As String Dim v_CheminFichier As String Dim v_Commande As String Dim v_NoFichier As Integer Dim oShell As Variant Dim s As String Dim a As Variant Dim l As Long
SIW_TacheActive = False If p_NomProgramme = "" Then Exit Function End If
' ********************************* ATESTER **************************************** a = SIW_aTachesActives If Isarray(a) Then For l = Lbound(a) To Ubound(a) If Instr(1, a(l), p_NomProgramme, 5) > 0 Then SIW_TacheActive = True Exit For End If Next End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIW_ResolutionEcran(p_Resolution As gt_Resolution) As String On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Rectangle As gt_Rectangle Dim v_hWnd As Long ' Dim RetVal As Long
v_hWnd = GetDesktopWindow () ' RetVal = GetWindowRect(v_hWnd, v_Rectangle) Call GetWindowRect(v_hWnd, v_Rectangle) p_Resolution.Largeur = v_Rectangle.x2 - v_Rectangle.x1 p_Resolution.Longeur = v_Rectangle.y2 - v_Rectangle.y1 SIW_ResolutionEcran = CStr(p_Resolution.Largeur) & "x" & CStr(p_Resolution.Longeur) Exit Function
GererErreur: SIW_ResolutionEcran = "ERR" Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIW, gc_Element_SIW, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit
Dim gnsSFH As Notessession

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant) Dim v_Now As Variant
If gnsSFH Is Nothing Then Set gnsSFH = New Notessession End If v_Now = Now
' Mise à jour de l'historique If Source.Isnewdoc Then Source.Document.HistoDC = v_Now Source.Document.HistoUC = gnsSFH.UserName Source.Document.HistoDM = "" Source.Document.HistoUM = "" Else If Source.Document.HistoDC(0) = "" Then Source.Document.HistoDC = Source.Document.Created Source.Document.HistoUC = gnsSFH.UserName End If Source.Document.HistoDM = v_Now Source.Document.HistoUM = gnsSFH.UserName End If End Sub

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_NotesDatabase" Use "SL_Clipboard"

Sub Initialize On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v_URL As String
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase
v_URL = SINDB_NotesURL(ndb) Call SLCl_AssignerTexteClipBoard(v_URL)
Print "L'URL de la base de documents a été copié dans le clipboard." Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_OK, GetThreadInfo(1), "Erreur " & CStr(Err()) & " à la ligne " & CStr(Erl()) & ": " & Error()) Exit Sub End Sub
Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_NotesDocument" Use "SL_Clipboard"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim ns As New NotesSession Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_URL As String
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then Print "Aucun document sélectionné." Exit Sub ElseIf ndc.Count > 1 Then Print "Un seul document doit être sélectionné." Exit Sub End If
Set nd = ndc.GetFirstDocument v_URL = SIND_NotesURL(nd) If v_URL = "" Then Print "Aucun document sélectionné." Exit Sub End If
Call SLCl_AssignerTexteClipBoard(v_URL)
Call nuiws.CurrentView.DeselectAll Print "L'URL du document a été copié dans le clipboard." Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_OK, GetThreadInfo(1), "Erreur " & Cstr(Err()) & " à la ligne " & Cstr(Erl()) & ": " & Error()) Exit Sub End Sub
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_Insertions" 'Use "SI_tString" Use "SL_SalesforceAPI" Use "x_SICl" Use "x_SIRR"

Dim gns_SIClSf As NotesSession Dim gndb_SIClSf As NotesDatabase
Dim gnv_Bann22_SIClSf As NotesView Dim gnv_Bann23_SIClSf As NotesView
' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIClSf = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIClSf = "SDSCl_Salesforce"
'=================================================================================================================================================== Class SIClSf_clSync Public Source As String Public ClientNoFmt As String Public NoClientRapid As String Public nd_Clie As NotesDocument Public ConnexionAPI As SLSf_clConnexionAPI Public AccountID As String Public Account As SLSf_clObject Public lnd_RepresentantsByXId List As NotesDocument Public NbRepresentants As Integer End Class

Sub Initialize
End Sub

'=================================================================================================================================================== Sub SIClSf_Initialisations On Error GoTo GererErreur
If gns_SIClSf Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIClSf = New NotesSession Set gndb_SIClSf = gns_SIClSf.Currentdatabase End If
Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIClSf, gc_Element_SIClSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'=================================================================================================================================================== Sub SIClSf_ListeRepresentants(pcl_Sync As SIClSf_clSync) On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As NotesDocument Dim v_IdUserSF As String Dim v_NbMaj As Integer
If pcl_Sync.NbRepresentants > 0 Then Exit Sub End If
Call xSIRR_Initialisations Set nv = gndb_xSIRR.GetView("V_Repr36") Call nv.Refresh
Set nd = nv.GetFirstDocument Do Until nd Is Nothing v_IdUserSF = xVar(nd, "Repr_IdUserSF", "") If v_IdUserSF <> "" Then Set pcl_Sync.lnd_RepresentantsByXId(v_IdUserSF) = nd v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
Set nd = nv.GetNextDocument(nd) Loop
pcl_Sync.NbRepresentants = v_NbMaj Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIClSf, gc_Element_SIClSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SIClSf_MajItemsClient(pcl_Sync As SIClSf_clSync) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_SalesforceId As String Dim v_BannieresSF As String Dim a_BannieresDescSF As Variant Dim nd_Bann As NotesDocument Dim v_Banniere As String Dim nd_Repr As NotesDocument Dim v_NoRepresentant As Long Dim v_IdRepresentant As String Dim v_NomRepresentant As String Dim v_ErreurSF As String Dim i As Integer
SIClSf_MajItemsClient = 0 v_Maj = False
Call xGDK_Initialisations If gnv_Bann22_SIClSf Is Nothing Then Set gnv_Bann22_SIClSf = gndbGDK_xGDK.GetView("V_Bann22") Call gnv_Bann22_SIClSf.Refresh End If If gnv_Bann23_SIClSf Is Nothing Then Set gnv_Bann23_SIClSf = gndbGDK_xGDK.GetView("V_Bann23") Call gnv_Bann23_SIClSf.Refresh End If
If xVar(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_ClientCodeAct", 0) = 1 Then ' Client actif
v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoAccountSF", pcl_Sync.Account.ExtraireValeur("Id", ""), False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoAccountSFParent", pcl_Sync.Account.ExtraireValeur("ParentId", ""), False) Or v_Maj
v_BannieresSF = pcl_Sync.Account.ExtraireValeur("OEM2__c", "") If v_BannieresSF = "" Then v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_BannieresSF", "", False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_BannieresDescSF", "", False) Or v_Maj Else a_BannieresDescSF = Split(v_BannieresSF, ";") ReDim a_BannieresSF(LBound(a_BannieresDescSF) To UBound(a_BannieresDescSF)) As String For i = LBound(a_BannieresDescSF) To UBound(a_BannieresDescSF) Set nd_Bann = gnv_Bann23_SIClSf.GetDocumentByKey(a_BannieresDescSF(i), True) If nd_Bann Is Nothing Then Set nd_Bann = gnv_Bann22_SIClSf.GetDocumentByKey(a_BannieresDescSF(i), True) End If a_BannieresSF(i) = xVar(nd_Bann, "Bann_Code", "XX") a_BannieresDescSF(i) = xVar(nd_Bann, "Bann_Description", a_BannieresDescSF(i)) Next v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_BannieresSF", a_BannieresSF, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_BannieresDescSF", a_BannieresDescSF, False) Or v_Maj End If
If pcl_Sync.Source = "SDS" Then v_NoRepresentant = 0 v_IdRepresentant = "" v_NomRepresentant = "" v_SalesforceId = pcl_Sync.Account.ExtraireValeur("OwnerId", "") If v_SalesforceId <> "" Then If IsElement(pcl_Sync.lnd_RepresentantsByXId(v_SalesforceId)) Then Set nd_Repr = pcl_Sync.lnd_RepresentantsByXId(v_SalesforceId) v_NoRepresentant = xVar(nd_Repr, "Repr_NoRepresentant", "") v_IdRepresentant = xVar(nd_Repr, "Repr_NotesId", "") v_NomRepresentant = xVar(nd_Repr, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "") End If End If v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoChargeCompteSF", v_SalesforceId, False) Or v_Maj If v_NoRepresentant > 0 Then v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoChargeCompte", CStr(v_NoRepresentant), False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_IdChargeCompte", v_IdRepresentant, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NomChargeCompte", v_NomRepresentant, False) Or v_Maj Else v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoChargeCompte", "", False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_IdChargeCompte", "", False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NomChargeCompte", "", False) Or v_Maj v_ErreurSF = "R" End If
v_NoRepresentant = 0 v_IdRepresentant = "" v_NomRepresentant = "" v_SalesforceId = pcl_Sync.Account.ExtraireValeur("Regional_Sales_Director__c", "") If v_SalesforceId <> "" Then If IsElement(pcl_Sync.lnd_RepresentantsByXId(v_SalesforceId)) Then Set nd_Repr = pcl_Sync.lnd_RepresentantsByXId(v_SalesforceId) v_NoRepresentant = xVar(nd_Repr, "Repr_NoRepresentant", "") v_IdRepresentant = xVar(nd_Repr, "Repr_NotesId", "") v_NomRepresentant = xVar(nd_Repr, "Repr_NomRepresentant", "") End If End If v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoDirecteurCompteSF", v_SalesforceId, False) Or v_Maj If v_NoRepresentant > 0 Then v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoDirecteurCompte", CStr(v_NoRepresentant), False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_DirecteurCompte", v_IdRepresentant, False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NomDirecteurCompte", v_NomRepresentant, False) Or v_Maj Else v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoDirecteurCompte", "", False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_DirecteurCompte", "", False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NomDirecteurCompte", "", False) Or v_Maj v_ErreurSF = "D" End If End If Else ' Client inactif v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoAccountSF", "", False) Or v_Maj v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_NoAccountSFParent", "", False) Or v_Maj End If
v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(pcl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_ErreurSF", v_ErreurSF, False) Or v_Maj If v_Maj Then SIClSf_MajItemsClient = 1 End If Exit Function
GererErreur: SIClSf_MajItemsClient = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIClSf, gc_Element_SIClSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SIClSf_SyncAccount(p_AccountId As String, pnd_Clie As NotesDocument, pcl_ConnexionAPI As SLSf_clConnexionAPI, p_Source As String) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim cl_Sync As New SIClSf_clSync
Dim v_Resultat As Integer Dim v_NbMaj As Integer Dim v_Maj As Boolean
' Initialisations SIClSf_SyncAccount = 0 Call SIClSf_Initialisations Call SIClSf_ListeRepresentants(cl_Sync) If p_Source = "" Then cl_Sync.Source = "SDS" Else cl_Sync.Source = p_Source End If cl_Sync.AccountId = p_AccountId
If pnd_Clie Is Nothing Then SIClSf_SyncAccount = -1 Exit Function End If Set cl_Sync.nd_Clie = pnd_Clie cl_Sync.ClientNoFmt = xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_ClientNoFmt", "") cl_Sync.NoClientRapid = xVar(pnd_Clie, "Clie_NoClientRapidRTC", "")
If Not (pcl_ConnexionAPI Is Nothing) Then Set cl_Sync.ConnexionAPI = pcl_ConnexionAPI End If
' Extraire le compte de Salesforce v_Resultat = SIClSf_ExtraireAccount(cl_Sync) If v_Resultat < 0 Then SIClSf_SyncAccount = -4 GoTo ErreurSync End If
' Maj le client de SI Clients v_Resultat = SIClSf_MajItemsClient(cl_Sync) If v_Resultat > 0 Then Call cl_Sync.nd_Clie.Save(True, False) ElseIf v_Resultat < 0 Then SIClSf_SyncAccount = v_Resultat GoTo ErreurSync End If
SIClSf_SyncAccount = v_Resultat Exit Function
ErreurSync: v_Maj = SIIx_MajItem(cl_Sync.nd_Clie, "Clie_ErreurSF", "E", False) Or v_Maj If v_Maj Then Call cl_Sync.nd_Clie.Save(True, False) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: SIClSf_SyncAccount = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIClSf, gc_Element_SIClSf, GetThreadInfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

'=================================================================================================================================================== Function SIClSf_ExtraireAccount(pcl_Sync As SIClSf_clSync) As Integer On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_NomProfilSalesforceAPI As String Dim v_Cle As String Dim v_Resultat As Integer
SIClSf_ExtraireAccount = 0
If pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI Is Nothing Then v_NomProfilSalesforceAPI = xVarProf("Prof_NomProfilSalesforceAPI", "") If v_NomProfilSalesforceAPI = "" Then SIClSf_ExtraireAccount = -2 Exit Function End If
Set pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI = New SLSf_clConnexionAPI(v_NomProfilSalesforceAPI) If pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI.Resultat < 0 Then SIClSf_ExtraireAccount = -2 Exit Function End If End If
If pcl_Sync.AccountId <> "" Then v_Cle = pcl_Sync.AccountId Else If pcl_Sync.Source = "Rapid" Then v_Cle = "DMT_Company_ID__c/" & pcl_Sync.NoClientRapid Else v_Cle = "SERTI_ID__c/" & pcl_Sync.ClientNoFmt End If
If Right(v_Cle, 1) = "/" Then SIClSf_ExtraireAccount = -1 Exit Function End If End If
Set pcl_Sync.Account = New SLSf_clObject(pcl_Sync.ConnexionAPI, "Account", v_Cle) If pcl_Sync.Account.Resultat < 0 Then SIClSf_ExtraireAccount = -3 Exit Function End If
SIClSf_ExtraireAccount = v_Resultat Exit Function
GererErreur: SIClSf_ExtraireAccount = -9 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIClSf, gc_Element_SIClSf, GetThreadInfo(1), v_Cle, False) Exit Function End Function
Option Public Option Declare Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

' Traitement des erreurs ' ----------------------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN= "SL" Const gc_Element_SLFWIN = "SL_FichierWIN"
Const FILE_SHARE_READ = &H1 Const OPEN_EXISTING = 3 Const FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE = &H20 Const GENERIC_READ = &H80000000
Declare Function CreateFile Lib "kernel32.dll" Alias "CreateFileA" (Byval lpFileName As String, Byval dwDesiredAccess As Long, Byval dwShareMode As Long, lpSecurityAttributes As Any, Byval dwCreationDisposition As Long, Byval dwFlagsAndAttributes As Long, Byval hTemplateFile As Long) As Long Declare Function CloseHandle Lib "kernel32.dll" (Byval hObject As Long) As Long
Type FILETIME dwLowDateTime As Long dwHighDateTime As Long End Type
Type SYSTEMTIME wYear As Integer wMonth As Integer wDayOfWeek As Integer wDay As Integer wHour As Integer wMinute As Integer wSecond As Integer wMilliseconds As Integer End Type
Declare Function FileTimeToLocalFileTime Lib "kernel32.dll" (lpFileTime As FILETIME, lpLocalFileTime As FILETIME) As Long Declare Function GetFileTime& Lib "kernel32" (Byval hFile As Long, lpCreationTime As FILETIME, lpLastAccessTime As FILETIME, lpLastWriteTime As FILETIME) Declare Function FileTimeToSystemTime& Lib "kernel32" (lpFileTime As FILETIME, lpSystemTime As SYSTEMTIME)

Function SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_NomFichier As String) As String ' RQ51336 PBE ' Retourne un nom de fichier unique en ajoutent "(n)" au nom du fichier au besoin ' Fichier ABC.PDF --> Fichier ABC (2).pdf ' p_NomFichier : Le nom du fichier doit inclure le chemin d'accès On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_Continuer As Boolean Dim v_Dossier As String Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_Suffixe As String Dim i As integer Dim v_NomFichierUnique As String Dim s As string
SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique = p_NomFichier v_Continuer = False
If p_NomFichier <> "" Then If InStr(p_NomFichier, "\") > 0 Then s = Dir$(p_NomFichier, 0) If s <> "" Then v_Continuer = True End If End If End If
If v_Continuer then v_Dossier = StrLeftBack(p_NomFichier, "\") & "\" v_NomFichier = StrRightBack(p_NomFichier, "\")
If InStr(v_NomFichier, ".") > 0 Then v_Suffixe = "." & StrRightBack(v_NomFichier, ".") v_NomFichier = StrLeftBack(v_NomFichier, ".") Else v_Suffixe = "" End If
i = 1 Do i = i + 1 v_NomFichierUnique = v_Dossier & v_NomFichier & " (" & CStr(i) & ")" & v_Suffixe s = Dir$(v_NomFichierUnique) Loop Until s = ""
SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique = v_NomFichierUnique End if Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomFichier, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_DateFichier(p_CheminFichier As String, p_TypeInfo As String) As Variant '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de retourne les date de création, modif ou consutation d'un fichier windows. ' Paramètres : p_TypeInfo ---> Le type info fichier a retourner ( C = date création, M = date modification, A = date dern. accès) '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 76 Goto FichierInexistant
Dim v_ValRetour As Long ' valeur de retour Dim v_Date As Variant Dim v_Fichier As Long ' handle du fichier ouvert Dim v_DateCreation As FILETIME ' variable pour date et heure de création Dim v_DateDernAcces As FILETIME ' variable pour date et heure dernière consultation Dim v_DateModif As FILETIME ' varible pour date et heure de dernière modification Dim v_DateFichier As SYSTEMTIME ' variable pour manipuler l'heure et date de FILETIME
' Initialisations SLFWIN_DateFichier = ""
If Dir$(p_CheminFichier) = "" Then Goto FichierInexistant End If
v_Fichier = CreateFile(p_CheminFichier, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, Byval Clng(0), OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_ARCHIVE, 0) If v_Fichier = -1 Then Exit Function End If
' Retourne heures...creation, dern-accès, and dern-modification. v_ValRetour = GetFileTime(v_Fichier, v_DateCreation, v_DateDernAcces, v_DateModif)
' Fermer la connection au fichier. v_ValRetour = CloseHandle(v_Fichier) If v_ValRetour = 0 Then Print "ERREUR - Le fichier " & p_CheminFichier & " n'a pas été fermé normalement. (" & Cstr(v_ValRetour) & ")" End If
' Convertir la zone pour l'heure et Convertir le format FILETIME en format SYSTEMTIME Select Case p_TypeInfo Case "C" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateCreation, v_DateCreation) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateCreation, v_DateFichier) Case "M" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateModif, v_DateModif) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateModif, v_DateFichier) Case "A" v_ValRetour = FileTimeToLocalFileTime(v_DateDernAcces, v_DateDernAcces) v_ValRetour = FileTimeToSystemTime(v_DateDernAcces, v_DateFichier) End Select
v_Date = Evaluate(| @Date(| & v_DateFichier.wYear & |;| & v_DateFichier.wMonth & |;| & v_DateFichier.wDay & _ |;| & v_DateFichier.wHour & |;| & v_DateFichier.wMinute & |;| & v_DateFichier.wSecond & |) |)
If Isarray(v_Date) Then SLFWIN_DateFichier = v_Date(0) End If Exit Function
FichierInexistant: Print "Fichier " & p_CheminFichier & " introuvable." Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64(p_CheminFichierOrigine As String, p_CheminFichierDestination As String, p_Remplacer As Boolean) As Boolean '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet de convertir un fichier en base 64. '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_FichierTempOrigine As Boolean Dim v_CheminFichierOrigine As String Dim v_CheminFichierTempDestination As String Dim a_Commande(1) As String Dim v_Commande As String Dim i As integer Dim v_Resultat As Integer
' Initialisations SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64 = False
' Validation des paramètres If p_CheminFichierOrigine = "" Then Exit function End If If Dir$(p_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) = "" Then Exit function End If
v_CheminFichierOrigine = p_CheminFichierOrigine p_CheminFichierDestination = Replace(p_CheminFichierDestination, |’|, |-|)
v_FichierTempOrigine = False If InStr(v_CheminFichierOrigine, |’|) > 0 Then v_CheminFichierOrigine = p_CheminFichierDestination & ".si.tmp1" If Dir$(v_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierOrigine End If FileCopy p_CheminFichierOrigine, v_CheminFichierOrigine v_FichierTempOrigine = True End If
If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then If p_Remplacer then Kill p_CheminFichierDestination Else p_CheminFichierDestination = SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_CheminFichierDestination) End if End If
' Suppression du fichier temporaire v_CheminFichierTempDestination = p_CheminFichierDestination & ".si.tmp2" If Dir$(v_CheminFichierTempDestination, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierTempDestination End If
' ===== Encodage du fichier ===== ' certutil -encode [Origine] [Temporaire] && findstr /v /c:- [Temp] > [Destination] && del [Temp] %rem a_Commande(0) = |/c certutil -encode "| & p_CheminFichierOrigine & |" "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |"| a_Commande(1) = |/c findstr /v /c:- "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |" > "| & p_CheminFichierDestination & |"| a_Commande(2) = |/c del "| & v_CheminFichierTemp & |"| %end rem
a_Commande(0) = |certutil -encode "| & v_CheminFichierOrigine & |" "| & v_CheminFichierTempDestination & |"| a_Commande(1) = |findstr /v /c:- "| & v_CheminFichierTempDestination & |" > "| & p_CheminFichierDestination & |"| v_Commande = |/c | & Implode(a_Commande, |&&|) v_Resultat = ShellExecute(0&, "open", "cmd", v_Commande, "", SW_HIDE) If v_Resultat < 32 Then Exit Function End If
' Attendre jusqu'à ce que le fichier encodé soit créé Do If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then Exit Do End If Sleep 1 i = i + 1 Loop Until i > 10 ' Maximum 10 secondes
' Supprimer les fichier temporaires On Error 75 Resume next If v_FichierTempOrigine Then If Dir$(v_CheminFichierOrigine, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierOrigine End if End If If Dir$(v_CheminFichierTempDestination, 0) <> "" Then Kill v_CheminFichierTempDestination End If
If Dir$(p_CheminFichierDestination, 0) <> "" Then SLFWIN_EncoderFichierBase64 = True End If
Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SLFWIN, gc_Element_SLFWIN, GetThreadInfo(1), p_CheminFichierOrigine & " --> " & p_CheminFichierDestination, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_AccesAuteur(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase Dim v_AccessLevel As Integer Dim a_UserNamesList As Variant Dim a_Items As Variant Dim ni As NotesItem
Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer
' Vérifier l'accès à la base de documents Set ndb = pnd.ParentDatabase v_AccessLevel = ndb.CurrentAccessLevel
If v_AccessLevel < ACLLEVEL_AUTHOR Then SIND_AccesAuteur = False Elseif v_AccessLevel > ACLLEVEL_AUTHOR Then SIND_AccesAuteur = True Else ' Vérifier l'accès au document a_UserNamesList = Evaluate("@Usernameslist") a_Items = pnd.Items For i = 0 To Ubound(a_Items) Set ni = a_Items(i) If ni.IsAuthors() Then For j = 0 To Ubound(a_UserNamesList) If Not Isnull(Arraygetindex(ni.Values, a_UserNamesList(j))) Then SIND_AccesAuteur = True Exit Function End If Next End If Next End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_ValeurItemEgale(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String, p_Valeur As Variant, ByVal p_Date As Boolean) As Boolean ' Vérifie si la valeur de l'item p_NomItem est égale à p_Valeur On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim v_ValeurDifferente As Boolean Dim a_ValeurOrig As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim ndt As New NotesDateTime("")
SIND_ValeurItemEgale = False v_ValeurDifferente = False
' Extraire les valeurs actuelles a_ValeurOrig = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If p_Date Then If IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Dates - retirer la portion heure For i = LBound(a_ValeurOrig) To UBound(a_ValeurOrig) ndt.LSLocalTime = a_ValeurOrig(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime a_ValeurOrig(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next End If
' Si la nouvelle veleur contient des dates, retirer la portion heure If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then For i = LBound(p_Valeur) To UBound(p_Valeur) ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur(i) Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur(i) = ndt.LSLocalTime Next ElseIf p_Valeur <> "" Then ndt.LSLocalTime = p_Valeur Call ndt.SetAnyTime p_Valeur = ndt.LSLocalTime End If End If
' Vérifier si la nouvelle valeur est différent de la valeur actuelle If IsArray(p_Valeur) Then If IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Les deux valeurs sont des tableaux If UBound(p_Valeur) <> UBound(a_ValeurOrig) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True Else For i = LBound(p_Valeur) To UBound(p_Valeur) If CStr(p_Valeur(i)) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig(i)) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True Exit For End If Next End If Else ' p_Valeur est un tableau mais pas a_ValeurOrig If UBound(p_Valeur) > 0 Then v_ValeurDifferente = True ElseIf CStr(p_Valeur(0)) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True End If End If ElseIf IsArray(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' a_ValeurOrig est un tableau mais pas p_Valeur If UBound(a_ValeurOrig) > 0 Then v_ValeurDifferente = True ElseIf CStr(a_ValeurOrig(0)) <> CStr(p_Valeur) Then v_ValeurDifferente = True End If ElseIf CStr(p_Valeur) <> CStr(a_ValeurOrig) Then ' Ni p_Valeur ni a_ValeurOrig n'est un tableau v_ValeurDifferente = True End If
SIND_ValeurItemEgale = Not v_ValeurDifferente Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), p_NomItem, False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_AddedToFile(pnd As NotesDocument) As String
Dim db As String Dim s As String Dim ns As Integer
With pnd.ParentDatabase db = String$(1024, " ") SINAPI_OSPathNetConstruct 0, .Server, .FilePath, db End With
Dim hDB As Long SINAPI_NSFDbOpen db$, hDB If hDB = 0 Then Exit Function
Dim hNT As Long Dim T(1) As Long SINAPI_NSFNoteOpen hDB, Clng("&H" & pnd.NoteID), 0, hNT If Not hNT = 0 Then SINAPI_NSFNoteGetInfo hNT, 13, T(0) SINAPI_NSFNoteClose hNT s = Space(80) SINAPI_ConvertTIMEDATEToText 0, 0, T(0), s, 80, ns SIND_AddedToFile = Left$(s, ns) End If
SINAPI_NSFDbClose hDB End Function

Function SIND_DecrypterDocument(pnd As NotesDocument) As Boolean On Error Goto GererErreur On Error 17 Goto ErreurEncrypt
SIND_DecrypterDocument = False
If pnd.HasItem("Encrypt") Then ' Décryptage des champs ' --------------------------------- Forall ni In pnd.items If ni.isencrypted Then ni.isencrypted = False End If End Forall
' Crypter le document avec une clé bidon ' ------------------------------------------------------ Dim temp As New NotesItem(pnd, "x_Decrypter", "Cryptage") temp.IsEncrypted=True Call pnd.encrypt Call pnd.save(True, False)
' Retirer les champs relatifs au cryptage ' ---------------------------------------------------- Call pnd.removeitem("$Seal") Call pnd.removeitem("$SealData") Call pnd.removeitem("SecretEncryptionKeys") Call pnd.removeitem("Encrypt")
' Retirer le champ temporaire ' --------------------------------------- Call pnd.removeItem("x_Decrypter") Call pnd.Save(True, False) End If
SIND_DecrypterDocument = True Exit Function
ErreurEncrypt: Exit Function
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, Getthreadinfo(1), Cstr(pnd.UniversalID), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches(pnd As NotesDocument, p_CheminAcces As String, p_NomItemCle As String) As Long '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ' Ce script extrait le.s fichier.s attaché.s d'un document et le.s place dans le chemin d'accès spécifié (p_CheminAcces). ' ' Paramètres: ' pnd : document qui contient un ou des fichiers attachés ' p_NomItemRT : nom du champ RichText à traiter ' p_CheminAcces : chemin incluant le nom du fichier à détacher; si p_CheminAcces est vide, le TEMP de l'OS est alors utilisé ' p_NomItemCle : clé du document; ce texte est ajouté à la fin du nom du fichier. Exemple: <NoCandidat>_<NomFichier> ' ' Exemple: Fichier "ABC.PDF" et p_NomItemCle = 12345; le fichier sera nommé "12345_ABC.PDF" et s'il y a plusieurs fichiers au même nom alors ' le deuxième deviendra "12345_ABC (2).PDF". ' ' Valeur retournée: ' 0 : pas de fichier attaché dans le document ' -1 : une erreur s'est produite ' nombre de fichiers attachés traités '------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ On Error GoTo GererErreur
Dim a_NomFichierAttaches As Variant Dim i As Integer Dim neo As NotesEmbeddedObject
Dim v_NomFichier As String Dim v_LienArchive As String Dim v_NoDocument As String Dim v_Chemin As String Dim v_Format As String Dim s As String
Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Initialisations Call SIND_Initialisations SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = 0
a_NomFichierAttaches = Evaluate(|@AttachmentNames|, pnd) If a_NomFichierAttaches(0) = "" Then Exit Function End If
' Boucler sur tous les fichiers attachés du champ For i = 0 to UBound(a_NomFichierAttaches)
' Créer le dossier où sera placé le fichier If p_CheminAcces = "" Then On Error 75 Resume Next p_CheminAcces = Environ("Temp") & "\SIND" MkDir p_CheminAcces p_CheminAcces = p_CheminAcces & "\" Else s = Dir$(p_CheminAcces, 16) If s = "" Then MkDir p_CheminAcces End If End If
Set neo = pnd.Getattachment(a_NomFichierAttaches(i)) v_NomFichier = p_NomItemCle & "_" & neo.name v_Chemin = SLFWIN_NomFichierUnique(p_CheminAcces & "\" & v_NomFichier) v_NomFichier = StrRightBack(v_NomFichier, "\")
' Extraire le fichier et le placer dans le chemin indiqué Call neo.ExtractFile(v_Chemin) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1
Next
SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = v_NbMaj Exit Function
GererErreur: SIND_DetacherFichiersAttaches = -1 Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), v_NomFichier & " --> " & p_CheminAcces, False) Exit Function End Function

%REM Description: Converts a NotesDocument to an RTF-Document and saves it under the filePath Generates and removes some temporary Files while Working %END REM
Function SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF(pnd As NotesDocument, p_CheminAccesRTF As String) As boolean On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
Dim nd_Temp As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim v_CheminFichier_Body As String Dim v_CheminFichier_Fonts As String Dim v_CheminFichier_Temp As String Dim v_FileSize As Long
Dim i As Integer Dim f As Integer Dim fnew As Integer
SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF = False
Set nd_Temp = pnd.ParentDatabase.CreateDocument() Set nrti = nd_Temp.CreateRichTextItem("Body")
Call pnd.RenderToRTItem(nrti)
v_CheminFichier_Body = p_CheminAccesRTF & "_Body.cd" v_CheminFichier_Fonts = p_CheminAccesRTF & "_Fonts.cd" v_CheminFichier_Temp = p_CheminAccesRTF & ".cd"
Call SINAPI_MailGetMessageBodyComposite(nd_Temp.handle , "Body", v_CheminFichier_Body, v_FileSize) Call SINAPI_MailGetMessageBodyComposite(nd_Temp.handle , "$Fonts", v_CheminFichier_Fonts, v_FileSize)
' Concatener le body et les polices dans un seul fichier fnew = FreeFile Open v_CheminFichier_Temp For Binary As #fnew
' $fonts f = FreeFile Open v_CheminFichier_Fonts For Binary As #f Do Until EOF (f) Get #f,,i Put #fnew,, i Loop Close #f
' rich text Open v_CheminFichier_Body For Binary As #f ' skip 2 bytes Seek #f, 3 Do Until EOF (f) Get #f,,i Put #fnew,, i Loop Close ' Fin concatener
Call SINAPI_ExportRTF(v_CheminFichier_Temp, 0, 0, "", p_CheminAccesRTF)
SIND_ConvertirDocumentRTF = True Kill v_CheminFichier_Body Kill v_CheminFichier_Fonts Kill v_CheminFichier_Temp
Exit Function
ErrorHandler: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIND, gc_Element_SIND, GetThreadInfo(1), CStr(pnd.UniversalID), False) Exit Function End Function

Function SIND_NotesURL(pnd As NotesDocument) As String ' Retourne l'URL permettant d'ouvrir un document dans Notes. ' Format: Notes://DbReplicaId/ViewNoteUNID/DocUNID ' Format: Notes://DbReplicaId/0/DocUNID v1.9 On Error GoTo GererErreur
